# is the 20 Nov 2026 data-collection dashboard for naive students).
#

# computed from it for that browser session only. The uploaded file is deleted as soon as it has been read;
# models and plots live in the session's memory and a session-private temporary folder, which is deleted when
# the page is closed. Nothing is shared between students and nothing is written anywhere else (no caches on
# disk, no copies of downloads). Uploading a newer workbook replaces everything ("see results as data are added").

# Only the SHA-256 fingerprint of the password is stored here, never the password itself. Capitals matter.
# To set or change it: in R, run   openssl::sha256("Your Password")   (exactly as typed) and paste the result between the
# quotes below, then re-export the web version. Leave it as "" to turn the password screen off.

gate_ui <- function(hash) {
    if (!nzchar(hash)) return(NULL)
    tagList(
        tags$style(HTML("
            .gate { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 3000; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
                    padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E3D2F 0%, #4F7942 100%); }
            .gate-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px 28px; width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
                         box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25); text-align: center; }
            .gate-title { font-family: Cambria, Caladea, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #1E3D2F; margin-bottom: 10px; }
            .gate-msg { color: #B5523B; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 12px; min-height: 1.5em; }")),
        tags$div(id = "gate", class = "gate",
            tags$div(class = "gate-card",
                tags$div(class = "gate-title", "Biol 312 Parasitoid Dashboard"),
                tags$p("Enter the class password from Brightspace to open the dashboard (capitals matter)."),
                tags$input(id = "gate_pw", type = "password", class = "form-control form-control-lg",
                           placeholder = "Class password", autocomplete = "off", autocapitalize = "off",
                           autocorrect = "off", spellcheck = "false",
                           onkeydown = "if (event.key === 'Enter') tryGate();"),
                tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn btn-primary btn-lg w-100 mt-3", onclick = "tryGate()",
                            bs_icon("unlock"), " Open the dashboard"),
                tags$div(id = "gate_msg", class = "gate-msg", role = "alert"))),
        tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
            var GATE_HASH = '%s';
            async function gateSha256(text) {
              var buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text));
              return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(function(b) { return b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'); }).join('');
            }
            // the unlock lasts only for this browser tab: closing the tab or browser asks again (safer on shared lab computers)
            function gateRemembered() { try { return sessionStorage.getItem('pd_gate') === GATE_HASH; } catch (e) { return false; } }
            // tell the app the dashboard is open (it then shows the welcome window), once Shiny is connected
            function gateOpened() {
              var send = function() { Shiny.setInputValue('gate_open', Date.now(), {priority: 'event'}); };
              if (window.Shiny && Shiny.shinyapp && Shiny.shinyapp.isConnected && Shiny.shinyapp.isConnected()) send();
              else $(document).one('shiny:connected', send);
            }
            async function tryGate() {
              var box = document.getElementById('gate_pw'), msg = document.getElementById('gate_msg');
              var h = await gateSha256(box.value.trim());   // capitals matter
              if (h === GATE_HASH) {
                try { sessionStorage.setItem('pd_gate', GATE_HASH); } catch (e) {}
                document.getElementById('gate').remove();
                gateOpened();
              } else {
                msg.textContent = 'That password is not right. Check the Brightspace page and try again.';
                box.focus(); box.select();
              }
            }
            (function() {
              if (gateRemembered()) { var g = document.getElementById('gate'); if (g) g.remove(); gateOpened(); }
              else {
                [300, 1500, 4000].forEach(function(t) { setTimeout(function() {
                  var b = document.getElementById('gate_pw');
                  if (b && document.activeElement !== b && document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT') b.focus();
                }, t); });
              }
            })();", hash))))
}

# house style from the author's manuscript figures: classic panel, black axes, no grid, legend at the bottom
theme_house <- function(base_size = 14){
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = plot_font) +
        theme(
            text             = element_text(colour = "black"),
            axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
            axis.title       = element_text(colour = "black"),
            axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
            axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
            panel.grid       = element_blank(),
            strip.background = element_blank(),
            strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
            legend.position  = "bottom",
            legend.title     = element_text(colour = "black"),
            legend.key       = element_blank(),
            plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black", hjust = 0),
            plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
        )
}

BOX_FILL_ALPHA <- 0.12
box_outline <- function(mapping = NULL, ..., width = 0.5) {
    args <- list(...)
    if (!is.null(args$colour)) return(geom_boxplot(mapping, ..., fill = alpha(args$colour, BOX_FILL_ALPHA), outlier.shape = NA, width = width,
                                                   linewidth = 0.7, median.linewidth = 1.5, staplewidth = 0.35))
    fill_map <- aes(fill = after_scale(alpha(colour, BOX_FILL_ALPHA)))
    mapping <- if (is.null(mapping)) fill_map else { mapping[["fill"]] <- fill_map[["fill"]]; mapping }
    geom_boxplot(mapping, ..., outlier.shape = NA, width = width, linewidth = 0.7, median.linewidth = 1.5, staplewidth = 0.35)
}
pts_hollow <- function(..., size = 2.6) geom_point(..., shape = 16, alpha = 0.4, size = size)   # filled points, alpha 0.4
# paired plot on a numeric x: points (and the lines joining a pair) at 1 and 2, each box set just outside its points
paired_frame <- function(d, x) d %>% mutate(.x = factor(.data[[x]]), xn = as.numeric(.x), xb = xn + ifelse(xn == 1, -0.3, 0.3))
# box_colour = NULL colours each box by `colour`; give a fixed colour (e.g. "black") when a box mixes groups
paired_geoms <- function(colour, pair = "Trial_ID", y = "y", box_width = 0.2, box_colour = NULL) list(
    geom_line(aes(x = xn, y = .data[[y]], group = .data[[pair]]), colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.45),
    if (is.null(box_colour))
        geom_boxplot(aes(x = xb, y = .data[[y]], group = xn, colour = .data[[colour]], fill = after_scale(alpha(colour, BOX_FILL_ALPHA))), outlier.shape = NA,
                     width = box_width, linewidth = 0.7, median.linewidth = 1.5, staplewidth = 0.35)
    else geom_boxplot(aes(x = xb, y = .data[[y]], group = xn), colour = box_colour, fill = alpha(box_colour, BOX_FILL_ALPHA), outlier.shape = NA,
                      width = box_width, linewidth = 0.7, median.linewidth = 1.5, staplewidth = 0.35),
    geom_point(aes(x = xn, y = .data[[y]], colour = .data[[colour]]), shape = 16, alpha = 0.4, size = 2.6))
paired_x <- function(levels) scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels), labels = levels, expand = expansion(add = 0.45))

# ---- significance brackets (every group comparison carries one) ----
# b: one row per bracket with x1, x2 (x positions), lev (stacking level, 1 = lowest) and lab; plus the facet
# column(s) when faceted. ydata: the plotted data (y on the plotted scale) with the same facet column(s),
# so each bracket sits just above its own panel's data. log = TRUE for a log10 y axis.
sig_label <- function(p, adj = "") ifelse(is.na(p), "not testable",
    paste0(ifelse(p < 1e-4, "P < 0.0001", sprintf("P = %.4f", p)), ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""), ifelse(adj == "", "", paste0(" ", adj))))
sig_brackets <- function(b, ydata, y = "y", facet = NULL, log = FALSE, size = 3.3, step_frac = 0.11) {
    tf <- if (log) log10 else identity; itf <- if (log) function(v) 10^v else identity
    tops <- ydata %>% mutate(.ty = tf(.data[[y]])) %>% filter(is.finite(.ty)) %>% group_by(across(all_of(facet))) %>%
        summarise(.top = max(.ty), .rng = diff(range(.ty)), .groups = "drop")
    b <- if (length(facet)) left_join(b, tops, by = facet) else bind_cols(b, tops)
    b <- b %>% mutate(.step = ifelse(.rng > 0, .rng * step_frac, 0.1), yy = .top + .step * lev, tick = .step * 0.25)
    list(geom_segment(data = b, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = itf(yy), yend = itf(yy)), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.45, colour = "grey15"),
         geom_segment(data = b, aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = itf(yy), yend = itf(yy - tick)), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.45, colour = "grey15"),
         geom_segment(data = b, aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = itf(yy), yend = itf(yy - tick)), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.45, colour = "grey15"),
         geom_text(data = b, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = itf(yy + .step * 0.12), label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0,
                   size = size, family = plot_font, colour = "grey15"))
}

# ==========================================================
# DATA: read and analyse an UPLOADED workbook, for one browser session only
# ==========================================================

# Condition = dyad type (relabelled 21 Nov 2026; old codes still accepted):
# U x U (was B01, red and yellow both U), U x I (was B02, red is I, yellow is U), I x I (was B03, both I)
CONDITION_LEVELS <- c("U x U", "U x I", "I x I")
condition_factor <- function(x) {
    x <- recode(str_trim(as.character(x)), B01 = "U x U", B02 = "U x I", B03 = "I x I", "U x WI" = "U x I", "WI x WI" = "I x I")   # older workbooks used WI
    factor(x, levels = c(CONDITION_LEVELS, sort(setdiff(unique(na.omit(x)), CONDITION_LEVELS))))
}

# Read one uploaded workbook into this session's analysis tables. The result (and its model cache, tables$cache)
# belongs to the session that uploaded it and is dropped with it; nothing here is global or written to disk.
REQUIRED_SHEETS <- c("Trial_Metadata", "Behaviour_Events")
read_uploaded_workbook <- function(path) {
    # the file NAME does not matter: the format is read from the file's contents, so a renamed or mislabelled
    # workbook (e.g. an .xlsx saved as "data.xls", or with no extension) still works
    fmt <- tryCatch(readxl::format_from_signature(path), error = function(e) NA_character_)
    if (is.na(fmt)) stop("this is not an Excel workbook. Upload the class workbook saved from Excel (.xlsx); ",
                         "a CSV or Google Sheets link will not work, but File > Download > Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) will.")
    if (!grepl(paste0("\\.", fmt, "$"), path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        fixed <- tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", fmt)); file.copy(path, fixed)
        on.exit(unlink(fixed), add = TRUE)       # temporary copy, deleted as soon as the workbook has been read
        path <- fixed
    }
    sheets <- tryCatch(readxl::excel_sheets(path), error = function(e) stop("the workbook could not be opened (", conditionMessage(e), ")."))
    missing <- setdiff(REQUIRED_SHEETS, sheets)
    if (length(missing)) stop("This workbook has no ", paste(missing, collapse = " or "),
                              " sheet. Upload the class workbook (Parasitoid_Contest_Observations...xlsx).")
    tables <- tables_from_sheets(read_excel(path, sheet = "Trial_Metadata"), read_excel(path, sheet = "Behaviour_Events"))
    tables$mothers <- read_mothers_sheet(path, sheets)   # optional Single_Mothers sheet (Joel's single-mother counts)
    tables$simulated_class <- FALSE
    tables
}
tables_from_sheets <- function(metadata, events) {
    metadata <- metadata %>% mutate(Condition = condition_factor(Condition))
    rc <- lab8_recode(events); events <- rc$events          # Lab 8 ethogram (see lab8_recode.R)
    ft <- fill_missing_targets(events); events <- ft$events # methodological choice: blank Target = the class's usual Target
    tables <- build_analysis_tables(metadata = metadata, events = events)
    if (!nrow(tables$analysis_df)) stop("No behaviour events could be read from Behaviour_Events.")
    tables$emergence <- tryCatch(build_emergence(metadata, tables),
                                 error = function(e) list(data = tibble(), simulated = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e)))
    tables$stamp   <- paste0("t", format(Sys.time(), "%H%M%OS3"), sample.int(1e6, 1))   # identifies this dataset
    tables$key_all <- tables$stamp
    tables$cache   <- new.env()              # this dataset's model results only (see mm_cached in mixed_models.R)
    tables$recoded <- rc$changes             # events reclassified, for the New Behaviours page
    tables$targets_filled <- ft$filled       # events whose blank Target was filled, for the New Behaviours page
    tables
}

budget_long <- function(df) {
    df %>%
        mutate(prop_aggression = n_aggression / total_events, prop_assessment = n_assessment / total_events,
               prop_oviposition = n_oviposition / total_events, prop_defence = n_defence / total_events) %>%
        pivot_longer(starts_with("prop_"), names_to = "Behaviour", values_to = "Proportion") %>%
        mutate(Behaviour = recode(Behaviour, prop_aggression = "Aggression", prop_assessment = "Assessment",
                                  prop_oviposition = "Oviposition", prop_defence = "Defence"))
}

plot_contest <- function(tb) {
    ggplot(known(tb$contest_summary, "prop_oviposition"),
           aes(reorder(paste(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID), prop_oviposition), prop_oviposition, fill = status)) +
        geom_col(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
        geom_text(aes(label = round(prop_oviposition, 2)), hjust = -0.2, size = 4.2, family = plot_font) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
        coord_flip() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_cols, name = "Contest outcome") +
        labs(x = "Female identity", y = "Proportion of oviposition events") +
        theme_dash() + facet_wrap(~ Condition, scales = "free_y")
}

plot_arrival <- function(tb) {
    # paired by dyad (lines join the two females); bracket = mixed-model test (see Condition, section 2)
    d <- contest_data(tb, "arr") %>% paired_frame("x") %>% mutate(y = value + 1)
    m <- mm_contest(tb, "arr") %>% filter(comparison == OMNI, test == "main")
    ggplot(d) + paired_geoms("x", pair = "Dyad") + scale_colour_manual(values = outline_cols, guide = "none") +
        sig_brackets(tibble(x1 = 1, x2 = 2, lev = 1, lab = sig_label(m$p)), d, log = TRUE) +
        paired_x(c("Winner", "Loser")) + y_scale("arr", 0.12) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Arrival time (s, log scale)") + theme_dash() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# long figure captions are wrapped so they fit when a figure is drawn at the narrowest width (tablets; see MIN_PLOT_W)
wrap_caption <- function(p, width = 120) {
    wrap <- function(x) if (is.character(x)) paste(unlist(lapply(strsplit(x, "\n")[[1]], function(l) strwrap(l, width))), collapse = "\n") else x
    if (inherits(p, "patchwork") && !is.null(p$patches$annotation$caption)) p$patches$annotation$caption <- wrap(p$patches$annotation$caption)
    else if (inherits(p, "ggplot") && !is.null(p$labels$caption)) p$labels$caption <- wrap(p$labels$caption)
    p
}

server <- function(input, output, session){

    show_splash <- function() showModal(modalDialog(
        easyClose = TRUE, size = "l", footer = modalButton("Enter dashboard"),
        div(class = "splash text-center",
            img(src = "warren_wong_photo.jpeg", style = "width: 100%; max-width: 429px;",
                alt = "A Trissolcus japonicus female on brown marmorated stink bug eggs."),
            div(class = "small text-muted mt-1", photo_credit()),
            h2("Biol 312 Parasitoid Behavioural Contest Dashboard"),
            p(class = "text-muted", style = "font-size:1.1rem;", em("Trissolcus japonicus"), " results and analysis (version 2)"),
            p("It opens on a simulated class. Upload your class workbook on the Overview page to see your results; ",
              "it is used only while this page is open and nothing is saved."))))
    # with a password screen, the welcome window opens only after the password is accepted (a window open behind the
    # password screen would take the keyboard focus away from the password box)
    if (nzchar(app_password_sha256)) observeEvent(input$gate_open, show_splash(), once = TRUE) else show_splash()

    # DATA FOR THIS SESSION ONLY: the simulated class until a workbook is uploaded. An upload is read, analysed,
    # and its file deleted at once; the analysis lives in this session's memory and is dropped when it ends.
    session_tb <- reactiveVal(NULL)
    upload_name <- reactiveVal(NULL)
    tb <- reactive(if (is.null(session_tb())) SIM_TB else session_tb())
    observeEvent(input$upload, {
        path <- input$upload$datapath
        res <- withProgress(message = "Reading and analysing the workbook", value = 0.3,
                            tryCatch(read_uploaded_workbook(path), error = function(e) e))
        unlink(path)                                   # the uploaded file itself is deleted as soon as it is read
        if (inherits(res, "error")) {
            showNotification(paste("Could not use this file:", conditionMessage(res)), type = "error", duration = 12)
        } else {
            session_tb(res); upload_name(input$upload$name)
            showNotification(sprintf("Showing your class: %d trials, %d females.", nrow(res$trial_summary), nrow(res$analysis_df)), type = "message")
        }
    })
    observeEvent(input$use_simulated, { session_tb(NULL); upload_name(NULL) })
    session$onSessionEnded(function() isolate({ session_tb(NULL); upload_name(NULL) }))
    output$data_banner <- renderUI({
        if (is.null(session_tb()))
            div(class = "alert alert-warning py-2 mb-0", bs_icon("exclamation-triangle"), strong(" SIMULATED CLASS DATA. "),
                "Every page shows a simulated class for demonstration. Upload your class workbook on the Overview page to see your results.")
        else div(class = "alert alert-success py-2 mb-0", bs_icon("check-circle"), strong(" Your class data: "), upload_name(),
                 ". Used only in this browser tab; nothing is saved, and it disappears when you close the page.")
    })
    output$data_source <- renderUI({
        t <- tb()
        p(class = "mb-2", strong(if (is.null(session_tb())) "Showing: simulated class" else paste("Showing:", upload_name())), " (",
          nrow(t$trial_summary), " trials, ", nrow(t$analysis_df), " females, ", sum(t$behaviour_freq$n), " events).")
    })


    # plots are drawn on demand and cached for this session only; key = the drop-down choice, if any
    # On narrow screens (tablets, phones) a figure is drawn at desktop width and scaled down to fit, so the statistics text
    # inside it is never cut off; height grows in proportion so the scaled figure keeps its usual height on screen.
    # Narrow side-by-side panels (nb_threat) are drawn at their own width, as on desktop.
    MIN_PLOT_W <- 950
    show_plot <- function(id, key_fun = function() "") {
        min_w <- if (id == "nb_threat") 0 else if (id == "mm_comp") 1200 else MIN_PLOT_W   # three panels side by side need more room
        out_w <- function() { w <- getCurrentOutputInfo()$width(); if (is.null(w) || w <= 0) MIN_PLOT_W else w }
        renderPlot({
            key <- key_fun()
            req(!is.null(key))
            plot_or_message(tb(), id, key)
        }, width = function() max(out_w(), min_w),
           height = function() round(plot_specs[[id]]$h * max(1, min_w / out_w())),
           res = 96, alt = id) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, id, key_fun(), cache = "session")
    }

    output$arrival_plot           <- show_plot("arrival_plot")
    output$arrival_success_plot   <- show_plot("arrival_success_plot")
    output$arrival_rank_plot      <- show_plot("arrival_rank_plot")
    output$state_network          <- show_plot("state_network")
    output$state_females          <- show_plot("state_females")
    output$state_perm             <- renderUI(state_perm_ui(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$wasp_plot              <- show_plot("wasp_plot",      function() input$wasp_response)
    output$predictor_plot         <- show_plot("predictor_plot", function() input$predictor)
    output$mm_dyad                <- show_plot("mm_dyad",      function() input$mm_dyad_measure)
    output$mm_status              <- show_plot("mm_status",    function() input$mm_status_measure)
    output$mm_contest             <- show_plot("mm_contest",   function() input$mm_contest_key)
    output$mm_predictor           <- show_plot("mm_predictor", function() input$mm_predictor_var)

    # DYAD TYPES (mixed models)
    output$mm_dyad_stats <- renderUI({ req(input$mm_dyad_measure); mm_card(mm_dyad(tb(), input$mm_dyad_measure)) }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$mm_dyad_measure, cache = "session")
    output$mm_status_stats <- renderUI({ req(input$mm_status_measure); mm_card(mm_status(tb(), input$mm_status_measure)) }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$mm_status_measure, cache = "session")
    output$mm_contest_stats <- renderUI({ req(input$mm_contest_key)
        mm_card(mm_contest(tb(), input$mm_contest_key), function(x) switch(x$test, interaction = paste0(x$comparison, ": × dyad type"),
                                                                           simple = paste0("Within ", x$comparison), paste0(x$comparison, ": contrast")))
    }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$mm_contest_key, cache = "session")
    output$mm_predictor_stats <- renderUI({ req(input$mm_predictor_var)
        mm_card(mm_predictor(tb(), input$mm_predictor_var),
                function(x) paste0(x$comparison, if (x$test == "interaction") ": slope × dyad type" else sprintf(": slope (β = %.2f)", x$beta)))
    }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$mm_predictor_var, cache = "session")
    output$emergence_plot         <- show_plot("emergence_plot")
    output$emergence_sex_plot     <- show_plot("emergence_sex_plot")
    output$sr_condition_plot      <- show_plot("sr_condition_plot")
    # Overview: Lab 2 key results (the same figures as their pages)
    output$takeaways              <- renderUI(takeaways_ui(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    # New Behaviours page: tables with how often each behaviour was recorded in the data shown
    output$nb_ethogram  <- renderUI(ethogram_table(tb()))
    output$nb_recode_table <- renderUI(reclassified_table(tb()))
    output$nb_target_fill  <- renderUI(target_fill_ui(tb()))
    output$nb_condition    <- show_plot("nb_condition")
    output$nb_power_table  <- renderUI(nb_power_table(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$nb_threat_status <- renderUI(threat_status_ui(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$nb_threat_plot  <- show_plot("nb_threat")
    output$mm_comp         <- show_plot("mm_comp")
    output$mm_wait         <- show_plot("mm_wait")
    # waiting intruders: the figure only with enough power; the table always
    output$mm_wait_ui      <- renderUI(if (wait_power(tb()) >= WAIT_POWER_MIN) plotOutput("mm_wait", height = "560px") else
        div(class = "alert alert-secondary", bs_icon("info-circle"), sprintf(" No figure: not enough data to compare dyad types (power %d%%, needs %d%%). See the table below.", round(100 * wait_power(tb())), round(100 * WAIT_POWER_MIN))))
    output$mm_wait_table   <- renderUI(wait_table(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$sr_super_plot          <- show_plot("sr_predictor_plot", function() input$sr_super)
    output$sr_contest_plot        <- show_plot("sr_predictor_plot", function() input$sr_contest)
    output$survival_plot          <- show_plot("survival_plot",     function() input$surv_pred)
    output$mothers_plot           <- show_plot("mothers_plot")
    output$mothers_stats          <- renderUI(mothers_stats_ui(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")

    # SEX RATIO (Lab 8)
    for (i in 1) local({ id <- paste0("sr_banner_", i); output[[id]] <- renderUI(sim_banner_ui(tb())) })
    output$emergence_stats <- renderUI(emergence_stats(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$emergence_sex_stats <- renderUI(emergence_sex_stats(tb())) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$sr_condition_stats <- renderUI({
        d <- tb()$emergence$data %>% filter(Wasps > 0)
        rates <- d %>% group_by(Condition) %>% summarise(p = sum(Males) / sum(Wasps), .groups = "drop")
        tagList(do.call(stat_list, c(list("Data" = if (tb()$emergence$simulated) "Simulated" else "Entered counts",
                                          "Model" = "Beta-binomial GLM, one model"),
                                     setNames(as.list(sprintf("%.3f", rates$p)), paste("Proportion male,", rates$Condition)))),
                mm_card(sr_dyad_tests(tb())))
    }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, cache = "session")
    output$sr_super_stats   <- renderUI({ req(input$sr_super);   model_stats(tb(), input$sr_super, male_resp, "Proportion male") }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$sr_super, cache = "session")
    output$sr_contest_stats <- renderUI({ req(input$sr_contest); model_stats(tb(), input$sr_contest, male_resp, "Proportion male") }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$sr_contest, cache = "session")
    output$survival_stats   <- renderUI({ req(input$surv_pred);  model_stats(tb(), input$surv_pred, surv_resp, "Offspring survival") }) |> bindCache(tb()$stamp, input$surv_pred, cache = "session")
    output$emergence_table <- renderUI({
        tb()$emergence$data %>%
            transmute(Condition, Trial = Trial_ID, Eggs, Males, Females, Unemerged,
                      `Proportion male` = Prop_Male, `Total ovipositions` = Total_Ovi, `Excess ovipositions` = Excess,
                      `Self-superparasitism` = Self_Super, `Dyad superparasitism` = Dyad_Super, `Females laying` = Females_Laying,
                      Survival, Check = Count_Check) %>%
            dash_table()
    })

    # OVERVIEW
    output$n_trials     <- renderText(nrow(tb()$trial_summary))
    output$n_wasps      <- renderText(nrow(tb()$analysis_df))
    output$n_events     <- renderText(sum(tb()$behaviour_freq$n))
    output$n_behaviours <- renderText(nrow(tb()$behaviour_freq))

    # STATISTICS
    output$arrival_stats <- renderUI({
        df <- tb()$analysis_df

build_analysis_tables <- function(
    metadata,
    events
){
  
  # =====================================================
  # CONDITION LOOKUP
  # =====================================================
  
  condition_lookup <- metadata %>%
    
    select(
      Trial_ID,
      Condition
    ) %>%
    
    distinct()
  
  # =====================================================
  # EVENT CLEANING
  # =====================================================
  
  events <- events %>%
    
    left_join(
      condition_lookup,
      by = "Trial_ID"
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      Behaviour =
        str_trim(Behaviour),
      
      Behaviour =
        recode(
          Behaviour,
          "mounted" = "mount",
          "guard"   = "guarding"
        ),
      
      Time_sec =
        as.numeric(Time_sec)
      
    ) %>%
    
    # skip blank / incomplete rows (e.g. "trial end" markers with no wasp)
    filter(
      !is.na(Behaviour),
      Behaviour != "",
      !is.na(Wasp_ID),
      str_trim(Wasp_ID) != "",
      !is.na(Time_sec)
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # BEHAVIOURAL STATES
  # =====================================================
  
  behaviour_states <- c(
    
    bite      = "Aggression",
    grapple   = "Aggression",
    push      = "Aggression",
    chase     = "Aggression",
    pull      = "Aggression",
    mount     = "Aggression",
    threat_display = "Aggression",   # Lab 8 ethogram (wing/mandible display at the rival)
    dismount  = "Aggression",        # as in the transition networks (behaviour_category() in app.R)
    walk_while_bitten = "Aggression",

    probe      = "Assessment",
    drum       = "Assessment",
    dance      = "Assessment",
    grasp_egg  = "Assessment",
    antennate_rival = "Assessment",  # Lab 8 ethogram (antennal contact with the rival); approach and wait stay "Other"
    
    oviposit         = "Oviposition",
    oviposit_attempt = "Oviposition",
    
    guarding = "Defence"
    
  )
  
  events <- events %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      State =
        
        recode(
          
          Behaviour,
          
          !!!behaviour_states,
          
          .default = "Other"
          
        )
      
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # ARRIVAL TIMES
  # =====================================================
  # A wasp's arrival is her first event with Target = egg
  # (On_Eggs_YN was dropped from the data sheet, 10 Nov 2026;
  # in the pilot data both definitions give identical times).

  arrival_summary <- events %>%

    filter(
      tolower(str_trim(Target)) == "egg"
    ) %>%
    
    group_by(
      Trial_ID,
      Wasp_ID
    ) %>%
    
    summarise(
      
      arrival_time =
        min(Time_sec),
      
      .groups = "drop"
      
    ) %>%
    
    group_by(
      Trial_ID
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      arrival_rank =
        rank(arrival_time),
      
      owner =
        arrival_rank == 1
      
    ) %>%
    
    ungroup() %>%
    
    left_join(
      condition_lookup,
      by = "Trial_ID"
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # INDIVIDUAL SUMMARIES
  # =====================================================
  
  wasp_summary <- events %>%
    
    group_by(
      Trial_ID,
      Wasp_ID
    ) %>%
    
    summarise(
      
      total_events =
        n(),
      
      behaviour_richness =
        n_distinct(
          Behaviour
        ),
      
      n_aggression =
        sum(
          State == "Aggression"
        ),
      
      n_assessment =
        sum(
          State == "Assessment"
        ),
      
      n_oviposition =
        sum(
          State == "Oviposition"
        ),
      
      n_defence =
        sum(
          State == "Defence"
        ),
      
      .groups = "drop"
      
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # CONTEST SUCCESS
  # =====================================================
  
  contest_summary <- wasp_summary %>%
    
    group_by(
      Trial_ID
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      total_oviposition =
        sum(
          n_oviposition
        ),
      
      # Trials with no oviposition events: the share is 0/0, so it is
      # left NA (excluded from share plots/stats). n_oviposition stays 0.
      prop_oviposition =

        if_else(
          total_oviposition > 0,
          n_oviposition / total_oviposition,
          NA_real_
        ),

      status = case_when(

        total_oviposition == 0

        ~ "no oviposition",

        prop_oviposition ==
          max(prop_oviposition) &
          
          prop_oviposition >
          min(prop_oviposition)
        
        ~ "winner",
        
        prop_oviposition ==
          min(prop_oviposition) &
          
          prop_oviposition <
          max(prop_oviposition)
        
        ~ "loser",
        
        TRUE ~ "tie"

      )

    ) %>%

    ungroup() %>%

    # winners are always plotted (and listed) first, then losers, then ties
    mutate(
      status = factor(status, levels = c("winner", "loser", "tie", "no oviposition"))
    ) %>%
    
    left_join(
      condition_lookup,
      by = "Trial_ID"
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # MASTER DATASET
  # =====================================================
  
  analysis_df <- contest_summary %>%
    
    left_join(
      
      arrival_summary %>%
        
        select(
          
          Trial_ID,
          Wasp_ID,
          
          arrival_time,
          arrival_rank,
          owner
          
        ),
      
      by = c(
        "Trial_ID",
        "Wasp_ID"
      )
      
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      prop_aggression =
        n_aggression /
        total_events,
      
      prop_assessment =
        n_assessment /
        total_events,
      
      prop_defence =
        n_defence /
        total_events,
      
      oviposition_efficiency =
        n_oviposition /
        total_events
      
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # ARRIVAL OUTCOMES
  # =====================================================
  
  arrival_outcomes <- analysis_df %>%
    
    filter(
      status %in%
        c(
          "winner",
          "loser"
        )
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # TRANSITIONS
  # =====================================================
  
  events <- events %>%
    
    arrange(
      Trial_ID,
      Wasp_ID,
      Time_sec
    ) %>%
    
    group_by(
      Trial_ID,
      Wasp_ID
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      next_behaviour =
        lead(
          Behaviour
        )
      
    ) %>%
    
    ungroup()
  
  transition_edges <- events %>%
    
    filter(
      !is.na(next_behaviour)
    ) %>%
    
    count(
      
      Condition,
      
      Behaviour,
      
      next_behaviour,
      
      name = "weight"
      
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # FREQUENCIES
  # =====================================================
  
  behaviour_freq <- events %>%
    
    count(
      
      Condition,
      
      Behaviour,
      
      sort = TRUE
      
    )
  
  state_freq <- events %>%
    
    count(
      
      Condition,
      
      State,
      
      sort = TRUE
      
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # TRIAL SUMMARY
  # =====================================================
  
  trial_summary <- contest_summary %>%
    
    group_by(
      
      Trial_ID,
      
      Condition
      
    ) %>%
    
    summarise(
      
      total_oviposition =
        sum(n_oviposition),
      
      total_aggression =
        sum(n_aggression),
      
      total_assessment =
        sum(n_assessment),
      
      total_defence =
        sum(n_defence),
      
      # No dominant wasp when nobody oviposited
      dominant_wasp =

        if (sum(n_oviposition) > 0)
          Wasp_ID[
            which.max(
              prop_oviposition
            )
          ]
        else NA_character_,
      
      max_prop_oviposition =
        if (sum(n_oviposition) > 0)
          max(prop_oviposition)
        else NA_real_,
      
      .groups = "drop"
      
    )
  
  # =====================================================
  # RETURN
  # =====================================================
  
  return(
    
    list(
      
      metadata =
        metadata,
      
      events =
        events,
      
      analysis_df =
        analysis_df,
      
      contest_summary =
        contest_summary,
      
      arrival_summary =
        arrival_summary,
      
      arrival_outcomes =
        arrival_outcomes,
      
      behaviour_freq =
        behaviour_freq,
      
      state_freq =
        state_freq,
      
      transition_edges =
        transition_edges,
      
      trial_summary =
        trial_summary
      
    )
    
  )
  
}

FIGURE_CATALOGUE <- lapply(seq_along(FIGURE_CATALOGUE), function(i) { f <- FIGURE_CATALOGUE[[i]]; if (is.null(f$kind)) f$kind <- "core"
  f$num <- i; f$name <- sprintf("Figure_%02d_%s.png", i, f$file); f })
n_core_figures <- sum(vapply(FIGURE_CATALOGUE, function(f) f$kind == "core", logical(1)))
n_sexratio_figures <- length(FIGURE_CATALOGUE) - n_core_figures

# ---------- statistics text: the same model results the dashboard shows ----------
fs_rows <- function(r, labels = r$comparison) paste0("  ", labels, ": ", chi_plain(r))
fs_model <- function(fam) paste0(MODEL_NAME[[fam]], " with dyad as a random effect; likelihood-ratio tests.")
fs_within <- function(s, what) {
  m <- s %>% filter(test == "main"); i <- s %>% filter(test == "interaction"); sm <- s %>% filter(test == "simple")
  c(fs_model(m$fam[1]),
    fs_rows(m, paste0(what, " (adjusted for dyad type)")),
    if (nrow(i)) fs_rows(i, ifelse(i$comparison == OMNI, paste(what, "differs among dyad types"), paste(what, "x", i$comparison))),
    if (nrow(sm)) fs_rows(sm, paste(what, "within", sm$comparison)))
}
fs_slope <- function(s) {
  m <- s %>% filter(test == "main"); i <- s %>% filter(test == "interaction")
  c("Binomial GLMM (share of ovipositions) with dyad and female random effects; predictor standardised (per SD); likelihood-ratio tests.",
    sprintf("  Slope: beta = %.3f (logit scale); %s", m$beta, chi_plain(m)),
    fs_rows(i, ifelse(i$comparison == OMNI, "Slope differs among dyad types", paste("Slope x", i$comparison))))
}
fs_split <- function(tb, pv) c(
  "Binomial GLMM (share of ovipositions) with dyad and female random effects; predictor standardised (per SD); likelihood-ratio tests.",
  "One line per group, each with its own slope; the slope-difference test says whether they differ (P < 0.05). Group slopes: Holm-adjusted.",
  unlist(lapply(names(SPLITS), function(sp) { s <- mm_slope_split(tb, pv, sp)
    c(paste0("  ", if (sp == "dyad") "A. By dyad type" else "B. By female status (I vs U)",
             if (attr(s, "differ")) " (slopes differ)" else " (no evidence the slopes differ)"),
      sprintf("    %s%s: %s%s", ifelse(s$test == "simple", "Slope within ", ""), s$comparison,
              ifelse(is.na(s$beta), "", sprintf("beta = %.3f; ", s$beta)), chi_plain(s))) })))
fs_dyad <- function(s) c(paste(fs_model(s$fam[1]), "One model with all three dyad types; contrasts tested inside it."),
                         fs_rows(s, ifelse(s$comparison == OMNI, "Dyad type (overall)", s$comparison)))
fs_status <- function(s) c(fs_model(s$fam[1]), fs_rows(s))
fs_colour <- function(tb, var) {
  t <- mm_simple(tb, var, "Wasp_ID"); s <- mm_colour(tb, var)
  c(fs_model(t$fam), sprintf("  The two females of a dyad, all dyads: %s, n = %d females", chi_plain(as_tibble(t[c("chisq", "df", "p")])), t$n),
    fs_rows(s, paste("Red vs yellow within", s$comparison)))
}
fs_contest_desc <- function(tb) {
  ts <- tb$contest_summary %>% group_by(Trial_ID) %>% summarise(st = paste(sort(unique(as.character(status))), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop")
  own <- tb$analysis_df %>% filter(status == "winner")
  c("Descriptive figure.",
    sprintf("  %d trials: %d with a winner, %d tied, %d with no ovipositions; winners were first on the eggs in %d of %d contests.",
            nrow(ts), sum(grepl("winner", ts$st)), sum(ts$st == "tie"), sum(ts$st == "no oviposition"),
            sum(own$owner, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(own$owner))))
}
fs_emergence <- function(tb) { d <- tb$emergence$data
  sprintf("Descriptive: %d egg masses; %d males, %d females (proportion male %.3f); %d unemerged eggs; %d masses whose counts do not add up to Eggs_Host.",
          nrow(d), sum(d$Males), sum(d$Females), sum(d$Males) / max(1, sum(d$Wasps)),
          sum(d$Unemerged, na.rm = TRUE), sum(d$Count_Check != "OK", na.rm = TRUE)) }
fs_bb <- function(tb, key, surv = FALSE, count_super = FALSE) {
  d <- tb$emergence$data %>% filter(if (surv) Parasitized > 0 else Wasps > 0) %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[key]]))
  t <- bb_lrt(d, if (surv) surv_resp else male_resp, key)
  c(if (count_super) sprintf("Superparasitized = more ovipositions recorded than eggs in the mass (self or dyad): %d of %d egg masses.",
                             sum(d$Superparasitized == "Superparasitized"), nrow(d)),
    if (is.na(t$chisq)) "  Beta-binomial GLM: model could not be fitted"
    else sprintf("  Beta-binomial GLM (likelihood-ratio test): %s, n = %d egg masses",
                 chi_plain(tibble(chisq = t$chisq, df = t$df, p = t$p)), t$n))
}

# ---------- write the ZIP ----------
# export_dir: NULL (default) = keep no copy. The ZIP goes only to the file Shiny streams to the browser.
# which Lab 8 figures the uploaded data can produce (never from simulated counts)
lab8_ready <- function(tb) list(sexratio = !is.null(tb$emergence) && !isTRUE(tb$emergence$simulated) && nrow(tb$emergence$data) > 0,
                                mothers = !is.null(tb$mothers))
# which = "all" (every figure the data allow) or "lab8" (Lab 8 sex-ratio and single-mother figures only).
# Figures keep their catalogue numbers in both ZIPs, so "Figure 21" is the same figure in either download.
write_figure_set <- function(file, tables, export_dir = NULL, which = c("all", "lab8")) {
  which <- match.arg(which)
  tb <- tables
  tmpdir <- tempfile("figures_"); dir.create(tmpdir)
  rd <- lab8_ready(tb); sr_ready <- rd$sexratio
  figs <- Filter(function(f) (which == "all" && f$kind == "core") || (f$kind == "sexratio" && sr_ready) || (f$kind == "mothers" && rd$mothers), FIGURE_CATALOGUE)
  no_titles <- theme(plot.title = element_blank(), plot.subtitle = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 10, 12))

  stats <- c(paste0("BIOL 312 PARASITOID CONTEST DASHBOARD (VERSION 2) - ", if (which == "lab8") "LAB 8 " else "", "FIGURE STATISTICS"), paste("Generated:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), "",
             strwrap(copyright_notice, width = 80), copyright_year, copyright_owner, "",
             "METHODS",
             strwrap(paste("Each figure and test is the one shown on the dashboard. Females in the same dyad are not independent, so",
                           "dyad (trial) is a random effect in every mixed model; each observer team scored one dyad, so it also absorbs",
                           "observer differences. Proportions: binomial GLMM with a female-level random effect for overdispersion;",
                           "behavioural richness: Poisson GLMM; arrival time: linear mixed model on log(s + 1). All tests are",
                           "likelihood-ratio tests (chi-square). Dyad types (U x U, U x I with red = I, I x I) are compared in one model",
                           "per measure; the planned contrasts (U x I vs the other two; U x U vs I x I) are Holm-adjusted and the other",
                           "pairwise contrasts are post hoc, Scheffe-adjusted. Sex ratio (Lab 8): beta-binomial GLMs, one egg mass per dyad.",
                           "Female and male emergence per host egg (Lab 8): one binomial GLMM per sex, cbind(wasps, host eggs - wasps) ~",
                           "dyad type + (1 | dyad), Wald chi-square test of dyad type.",
                           "P values to four decimals; below 0.0001 reported as P < 0.0001; * P < 0.05."), width = 80), "",
             "DATA PREPARATION (methodological choices)",
             strwrap(data_prep_text(tb), width = 80), "")
  section <- ""
  for (f in figs) {
    message("Figure ", f$num, ": ", f$file)
    if (f$section != section) { section <- f$section; stats <- c(stats, toupper(section), "") }
    p <- tryCatch(f$plot(tb), error = function(e) e)
    ok <- !inherits(p, "error") && !inherits(tryCatch({
      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(tmpdir, f$name), p + no_titles, width = f$w, height = f$h, dpi = 300, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
    }, error = function(e) e), "error")
    st <- tryCatch(f$stats(tb), error = function(e) paste("  Statistics unavailable:", conditionMessage(e)))
    stats <- c(stats, sprintf("FIGURE %02d. %s", f$num, f$title),
               if (ok) st else paste("  Not produced from the current data:", if (inherits(p, "error")) conditionMessage(p) else "drawing failed"), "")
  }
  if (!sr_ready && which == "all") stats <- c(stats, "LAB 8 SEX RATIO",
    sprintf("Figures %02d-%02d are added once emergence counts (Males_Emerged and Females_Emerged) are entered in the workbook.",
            n_core_figures + 1, length(FIGURE_CATALOGUE)))
  writeLines(stats, file.path(tmpdir, "Figure_Statistics.txt"), useBytes = FALSE)

  produced <- list.files(tmpdir, pattern = "^Figure_.*\\.png$")
  writeLines(c(paste0("BIOL 312 PARASITOID CONTEST DASHBOARD (VERSION 2) - ", if (which == "lab8") "LAB 8 FIGURES" else "FIGURE SET"), paste("Generated:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), "",
               strwrap(copyright_notice, width = 80), copyright_year, copyright_owner, "",
               sprintf("%d figures as 300 dpi PNG (ready for PowerPoint), the same figures and tests as the dashboard:", length(produced)),
               unlist(lapply(unique(vapply(figs, `[[`, "", "section")), function(s) {
                 ff <- Filter(function(f) f$section == s, figs)
                 sprintf("  Figures %02d-%02d  %s", ff[[1]]$num, ff[[length(ff)]]$num, s) })),
               if (!sr_ready && which == "all") sprintf("  Figures %02d-%02d  Lab 8 sex ratio: added once emergence counts are entered", n_core_figures + 1, length(FIGURE_CATALOGUE)),
               "Figure_Statistics.txt  Methods and the statistical results for every figure", "",
               "Colours: dashboard palette checked for colour-vision deficiency (U x U gold, U x I slate, I x I dark green).",
               "Boxes are outlines; points are individual females (or egg masses); grey lines join the two females of a dyad.",
               "Brackets show pairwise tests: unmarked = planned (Holm) or single tests; dagger = post hoc (Scheffe)."),
             file.path(tmpdir, "README.txt"))

  oldwd <- getwd(); setwd(tmpdir); on.exit({ setwd(oldwd); unlink(tmpdir, recursive = TRUE) }, add = TRUE)   # temp figures deleted
  zip::zipr(zipfile = file, files = list.files(pattern = "^(Figure_.*\\.png|Figure_Statistics\\.txt|README\\.txt)$"))
  if (!is.null(export_dir)) {          # version 2 (web app) keeps NO copy; a folder can be given for local use only
    keep_dir <- if (grepl("^([A-Za-z]:|[/\\\\])", export_dir)) export_dir else file.path(oldwd, export_dir)
    dir.create(keep_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    file.copy(file, file.path(keep_dir, paste0("Biol312_Parasitoid_Figure_Set_v2_", Sys.Date(), ".zip")), overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  invisible(file)
}

# =============================================================================
# LAB 8 ETHOGRAM RECLASSIFICATION
# Events coded with the Lab 6 ethogram are reclassified with the Lab 8 ethogram (see the New Behaviours page):
#   * "other" events whose Notes describe a listed behaviour get that behaviour (first matching rule wins);
#   * "other" events that only mark the end of a trial ("end", "stop") are removed;
#   * "drum" aimed at the rival (Target = rival) becomes antennate_rival (drum is now for host eggs only);
#   * misspellings ("grasp egg", "Leave") are corrected.
# Data already coded with the Lab 8 ethogram pass through unchanged. Used by app.R (uploads) and by
# build/derive_sim_params.R (so the simulated class carries the new behaviours too).
# Rules: Condition_Analysis/R_scripts/recode.R (Biol 312 Lab 6 folder), 21 Nov 2026.
# =============================================================================

LAB8_RULES <- tibble::tribble(~pattern, ~new,
  "^(end|stop|the end)$", "DELETE",
  "spreading wings|flipping wings|flapped wings|flapping|opening and closing wings|made display|flaring mandibles", "threat_display",
  "jousted|kicked|bumped yellow|just bumped", "push",
  "punched red with their antennae|testing out yellow|interact with rival", "antennate_rival",
  "attempted lunge and bite", "bite",
  "approaching|^approaching eggs$|slowly approaching", "approach",
  "^watching", "wait",
  "circling egg mass", "guarding",
  "walking in a circle|looking for yellow|walking away", "walk",
  "^entered|^entrered", "arrive",
  "^left$|on and off egg mass", "leave",
  "rubbing legs|^cleaning$|walk groom walk groom", "grooming",
  "antennae is twitching possibly drumming|^walk and drum$", "drum",
  "funny dance|weird dance", "dance")

LAB8_NEW_CODES <- c("threat_display", "antennate_rival", "approach", "wait")
# every code in the Lab 8 ethogram drop-down
LAB8_ALL_CODES <- c("bite", "grapple", "push", "chase", "pull", "mount", "dismount", "walk_while_bitten", LAB8_NEW_CODES,
                    "probe", "drum", "dance", "grasp_egg", "oviposit", "oviposit_attempt", "guarding",
                    "arrive", "leave", "walk", "run", "grooming", "immobile", "other")

# events: the Behaviour_Events sheet. Returns list(events = reclassified sheet, changes = one row per changed event).
lab8_recode <- function(events) {
  b    <- tolower(trimws(as.character(events$Behaviour)))
  note <- tolower(trimws(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(if ("Notes" %in% names(events)) events$Notes else NA), "")))
  tgt  <- tolower(trimws(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(if ("Target" %in% names(events)) events$Target else NA), "")))
  new  <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(events))
  oth  <- which(b %in% "other")                                   # 1. "other" + a matching note
  for (i in oth) { hit <- which(vapply(LAB8_RULES$pattern, function(p) grepl(p, note[i]), logical(1)))
                   if (length(hit)) new[i] <- LAB8_RULES$new[hit[1]] }
  new[b %in% "drum" & tgt %in% "rival"] <- "antennate_rival"      # 2. drumming on the rival
  new[b %in% "grasp egg"] <- "grasp_egg"                          # 3. spelling
  new[b %in% "leave" & events$Behaviour %in% "Leave"] <- "leave"
  ch <- which(!is.na(new))
  # Lab 8 data typed by students: any ethogram code written with capitals or spaces ("Threat display", "Wait")
  # is put in the standard form, so it is counted with its behaviour everywhere (not recorded as a reclassification)
  std  <- gsub("[ -]+", "_", b)
  norm <- which(is.na(new) & std %in% LAB8_ALL_CODES & as.character(events$Behaviour) != std)
  events$Behaviour[norm] <- std[norm]
  changes <- tibble::tibble(From = trimws(as.character(events$Behaviour[ch])), To = new[ch], Trial_ID = events$Trial_ID[ch])
  events$Behaviour[ch] <- new[ch]
  events <- events[!(events$Behaviour %in% "DELETE"), , drop = FALSE]
  list(events = events, changes = changes)
}

# MISSING TARGET: an event with no Target gets the Target the class used most often for that behaviour (from the
# events that do have one; e.g. arrive/oviposit/guarding -> egg, bite/chase -> rival, grooming -> arena). Arrival on
# the eggs is the first event with Target = egg, so trials with blank Targets (e.g. B02-07, none recorded) would
# otherwise have no arrival. Behaviours never given a Target stay blank. Returns list(events, filled = per-trial counts).
fill_missing_targets <- function(events) {
  if (!"Target" %in% names(events)) events$Target <- NA_character_
  tgt <- tolower(trimws(as.character(events$Target))); tgt[tgt %in% ""] <- NA
  b <- tolower(trimws(as.character(events$Behaviour)))
  known <- !is.na(tgt)
  usual <- if (any(known)) tapply(tgt[known], b[known], function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]) else character()
  miss <- which(!known & b %in% names(usual))
  events$Target <- as.character(events$Target)
  events$Target[miss] <- usual[b[miss]]
  filled <- tibble::tibble(Trial_ID = events$Trial_ID[miss], Behaviour = b[miss], Target = usual[b[miss]])
  list(events = events, filled = filled)
}

# the data-preparation choices in words (figure-set statistics file and the New Behaviours page)
TARGET_FILL_RULE <- paste(
  "Events with a blank Target were given the Target that the class recorded most often for that behaviour",
  "(for example arrive, leave, oviposit, guarding, drum and dance = egg; bite, chase, grapple and push = rival;",
  "grooming, immobile and run = arena). This is a methodological choice: a female's arrival on the eggs is her",
  "first event with Target = egg, so without it a female whose Targets were left blank would have no arrival time",
  "(or a later one than she really had). Behaviours never given a Target stay blank.")
data_prep_text <- function(tb) {
  nr <- if (is.null(tb$recoded)) 0 else sum(tb$recoded$To != "DELETE"); nd <- if (is.null(tb$recoded)) 0 else sum(tb$recoded$To == "DELETE")
  tf <- tb$targets_filled; nf <- if (is.null(tf)) 0 else nrow(tf)
  paste(sprintf("Lab 8 ethogram: %d events were reclassified from their notes or Target, and %d end-of-trial markers were removed.", nr, nd),
        TARGET_FILL_RULE,
        if (nf > 0) sprintf("In these data, %d events in %d trials had their Target filled this way.", nf, dplyr::n_distinct(tf$Trial_ID))
        else "In these data, no Target was blank.")
}

# counts of reclassified events (From -> To), new behaviours first; for the New Behaviours page
lab8_change_table <- function(changes) {
  if (is.null(changes) || !nrow(changes)) return(tibble::tibble(From = character(), To = character(), Events = integer(), Trials = integer()))
  changes %>% group_by(From, To) %>% summarise(Events = n(), Trials = n_distinct(Trial_ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(To = ifelse(To == "DELETE", "(removed: end-of-trial marker)", To),
           new = To %in% LAB8_NEW_CODES) %>% arrange(desc(new), desc(Events)) %>% select(-new)
}

# ============================================================================= # DYAD-TYPE ANALYSES WITH MIXED MODELS (methods as in Class_Data_Figures_by_Condition.docx) # Dyad (trial) is a random effect: the two females in a dyad are not independent, and each # observer team scored one dyad, so (1 | Dyad) also absorbs observer differences. # proportions -> binomial GLMM, + observation-level (female) random effect for overdispersion # richness -> Poisson GLMM; arrival time -> LMM on log(s + 1) (axes show seconds on a log scale) # ONE model per measure with all three dyad types (U x U, U x I, I x I). Tests are likelihood-ratio tests: # overall dyad-type effect (2 df), then 1-df contrasts tested inside that same model: # PLANNED (set in the design): U x I vs the other two (-1/2, 1, -1/2) and U x U vs I x I (1, 0, -1); # these are orthogonal and together make up the 2-df overall test; Holm-adjusted across the two. # POST HOC: U x U vs U x I and U x I vs I x I; Scheffe-adjusted (contrast chi-square referred to the # overall test's df), which protects any contrast chosen after seeing the data. # A contrast is tested by refitting with the dyad-type means constrained to satisfy it (null) and comparing. # Female status: U x U = both U; U x I = red I, yellow U; I x I = both I. # Results are cached per workbook version and page choice. Sourced by app.R (local = TRUE). # ============================================================================= suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(lme4); library(ggtext); library(patchwork) }) OMNI <- "All three dyad types" DYAD_LEVELS <- c("U x U", "U x I", "I x I") CONTRASTS <- list( "U x I vs the other two" = list(w = c(-0.5, 1, -0.5), type = "planned"), "U x U vs I x I" = list(w = c(1, 0, -1), type = "planned"), "U x U vs U x I" = list(w = c(1, -1, 0), type = "post hoc"), "U x I vs I x I" = list(w = c(0, 1, -1), type = "post hoc")) POOLED <- "U x I vs the other two" STATUS_LEVELS <- c("U (v U)", "U (v I)", "I (v U)", "I (v I)") STATUS_CONTRASTS <- list( "U females: U x I vs U x U" = list(w = c(-1, 1, 0, 0), type = "post hoc"), "I females: U x I vs I x I" = list(w = c(0, 0, 1, -1), type = "post hoc")) WITHIN_UXI <- "I vs U within U x I" MM_MEASURES <- c("Share of ovipositions" = "share", "Proportion aggressive" = "agg", "Proportion assessment" = "ass", "Proportion guarding" = "def", "Behavioural richness" = "rich", "Arrival time" = "arr") MM_DYAD_MEASURES <- MM_MEASURES[MM_MEASURES != "share"] # shares sum to 1 within a dyad: every dyad type averages 0.5 MM_VAL <- c(share = "prop_oviposition", agg = "prop_aggression", ass = "prop_assessment", def = "prop_defence", rich = "behaviour_richness", arr = "arrival_time") MM_YLAB <- c(share = "Proportion of oviposition events", agg = "Proportion aggressive", ass = "Proportion assessment", def = "Proportion guarding", rich = "Behavioural richness", arr = "Arrival time (s, log scale)") var_kind <- setNames(names(MM_VAL), MM_VAL) mm_label <- function(k) names(MM_MEASURES)[match(k, MM_MEASURES)] MM_PREDICTORS <- c("Arrival time" = "arrival_time", "Aggression" = "prop_aggression", "Guarding" = "prop_defence", "Behavioural richness" = "behaviour_richness") MM_CONTESTS <- c("Winner vs loser: arrival time" = "arr", "Owner vs intruder: share of ovipositions" = "own") # ---------- models ---------- mm_ctl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)) fam_of <- function(kind) switch(kind, rich = "poisson", arr = "gaussian", "binomial") resp_of <- function(kind) switch(kind, share = "cbind(n_oviposition, total_oviposition - n_oviposition)", agg = "cbind(n_aggression, total_events - n_aggression)", ass = "cbind(n_assessment, total_events - n_assessment)", def = "cbind(n_defence, total_events - n_defence)", rich = "behaviour_richness", arr = "log(arrival_time + 1)") MODEL_NAME <- c(binomial = "Binomial GLMM", binomial_dyad = "Binomial GLMM", poisson = "Poisson GLMM", gaussian = "LMM, log(s + 1)") model_label <- function(fam) paste0(MODEL_NAME[[fam]], ", dyad random effect") RE <- list(binomial = " + (1 | Dyad) + (1 | FID)", poisson = " + (1 | Dyad)", gaussian = " + (1 | Dyad)", binomial_dyad = " + (1 | Dyad)") # binomial_dyad: one row per dyad (competition measures) fitm <- function(rhs, resp, d, fam) { f <- as.formula(paste(resp, "~", rhs, RE[[fam]])) suppressMessages(suppressWarnings( if (fam == "gaussian") lmer(f, data = d, REML = FALSE) else glmer(f, data = d, family = sub("_dyad$", "", fam), control = mm_ctl))) } # likelihood-ratio test from the two (ML) log-likelihoods: identical to anova(m0, m1) for these fits, and lets a # full model fitted once be compared with several null models (fewer fits = faster pages) lrt_fits <- function(m1, m0) { l1 <- logLik(m1); l0 <- logLik(m0); chisq <- max(0, 2 * (as.numeric(l1) - as.numeric(l0))); df <- attr(l1, "df") - attr(l0, "df") list(chisq = chisq, df = df, p = pchisq(chisq, df, lower.tail = FALSE), m1 = m1) } NA_TEST <- list(chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_integer_, p = NA_real_, m1 = NULL) fit_or_null <- function(rhs, resp, d, fam) tryCatch(fitm(rhs, resp, d, fam), error = function(e) NULL) lrt_pair <- function(m1, m0) if (is.null(m1) || is.null(m0)) NA_TEST else tryCatch(lrt_fits(m1, m0), error = function(e) NA_TEST) lrt <- function(resp, d, fam, full, null) lrt_pair(fit_or_null(full, resp, d, fam), fit_or_null(null, resp, d, fam)) # constraint columns for a contrast w over the levels of `group`: the null model keeps every mean # difference except the one w measures (basis of the space orthogonal to the intercept and w) add_constraint <- function(d, group, levels, w) { V <- MASS::Null(cbind(1, w)); idx <- match(as.character(d[[group]]), levels) for (j in seq_len(ncol(V))) d[[paste0(".v", j)]] <- V[idx, j] attr(d, "vcols") <- paste0(".v", seq_len(ncol(V))); d } # test contrast w inside the model `full`; `by` = a within-dyad term (x or z) for an interaction contrast. # m1 = the full model if already fitted (it is the same model for every contrast, so it is fitted once) contrast_lrt <- function(resp, d, fam, w, levels, by = NULL, base = NULL, m1 = NULL) tryCatch({ d <- add_constraint(d, "Grp", levels, w); v <- attr(d, "vcols") if (is.null(by)) { full <- paste(c("Grp", base), collapse = " + "); null <- paste(c(v, base), collapse = " + ") } else { full <- paste0(by, " * Grp"); null <- paste(c(by, "Grp", paste0(by, ":", v)), collapse = " + ") } if (is.null(m1)) m1 <- fitm(full, resp, d, fam) lrt_fits(m1, fitm(null, resp, d, fam)) }, error = function(e) NA_TEST) # adjust a set of contrast rows: planned -> Holm across the planned ones; post hoc -> Scheffe on omnibus df adjust_contrasts <- function(rows, omni_df) { rows$p_raw <- rows$p pl <- rows$type == "planned" if (any(pl)) rows$p[pl] <- p.adjust(rows$p_raw[pl], "holm") rows$p[!pl] <- pchisq(rows$chisq[!pl], omni_df, lower.tail = FALSE) rows$adj <- ifelse(pl, "Holm", "Scheffé"); rows } # ---------- data ---------- mm_data <- function(tb) { tb$analysis_df %>% mutate( Condition = droplevels(condition_factor(Condition)), Dyad = Trial_ID, FID = paste(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID), Type = case_when(Condition == "U x U" ~ "U", Condition == "I x I" ~ "I", tolower(Wasp_ID) == "red" ~ "I", TRUE ~ "U"), Opponent = case_when(Condition == "U x U" ~ "U", Condition == "I x I" ~ "I", tolower(Wasp_ID) == "red" ~ "U", TRUE ~ "I"), Group = factor(paste0(Type, " (v ", Opponent, ")"), levels = STATUS_LEVELS), Grp = factor(as.character(Condition), DYAD_LEVELS)) } mm_long <- function(a, k) a %>% mutate(value = .data[[MM_VAL[[k]]]]) %>% filter(!is.na(value)) all_three <- function(d) all(DYAD_LEVELS %in% d$Grp) # which side of a contrast is higher (from the raw group means) side_higher <- function(d, w, levels, grp = "Grp") { m <- tapply(d$value, factor(d[[grp]], levels), mean, na.rm = TRUE) if (any(is.na(m[w != 0]))) return(NA_character_) pos <- levels[w > 0]; neg <- levels[w < 0] est <- sum(w * m, na.rm = TRUE) side <- if (est > 0) pos else neg if (length(side) > 1) paste(side, collapse = " + ") else side } # ---------- cached result blocks ---------- # results are kept ONLY in this dataset's own environment (tb$cache, created per upload / per session): # never global, never on disk, so they disappear with the browser session mm_cached <- function(tb, what, key, f) { env <- tb$cache; if (is.null(env)) return(f()) id <- paste(what, key, sep = "|") if (is.null(env[[id]])) env[[id]] <- f() env[[id]] } row_of <- function(block, measure, comparison, t, n, ndy, higher = NA_character_, test = "main", fam = NA_character_, beta = NA_real_, type = "omnibus") tibble(block, measure, comparison, test, type, chisq = t$chisq, df = as.integer(t$df), p = t$p, p_raw = t$p, adj = "", n = n, dyads = ndy, higher, fam, beta) # dyad types for one measure: overall test + four contrasts from the same model mm_dyad <- function(tb, k) mm_cached(tb, "dyad", k, function() { d <- mm_long(mm_data(tb), k); fam <- fam_of(k); resp <- resp_of(k); n <- nrow(d); nd <- n_distinct(d$Dyad) if (k == "share" || !all_three(d)) return(bind_rows(row_of("dyad", k, OMNI, NA_TEST, n, nd, fam = fam), bind_rows(lapply(names(CONTRASTS), function(cn) row_of("dyad", k, cn, NA_TEST, n, nd, fam = fam, type = CONTRASTS[[cn]]$type)))) %>% mutate(higher = "n/a", adj = "")) m_full <- fit_or_null("Grp", resp, d, fam) # # ============================================================================= # OFFSPRING OF SINGLE MOTHERS: I vs U (Lab 8; data from Joel Bourgeois) # Each I (symbiont-infected) or U (cleared line) female was given a host egg mass on her own, so every emerged # offspring is hers: this gives each mother's own offspring number and sex ratio, which the contest egg masses # (two mothers per mass) cannot. Optional sheet "Single_Mothers" in the class workbook, one row per mother: # Mother_ID | Status (I or U; WI also accepted) | Eggs_Host (optional) | Males_Emerged | Females_Emerged | Notes (optional) # Tests (one row per mother, so no random effect): offspring number, negative binomial GLM (Poisson if the # negative binomial cannot be fitted); proportion of sons, beta-binomial GLM. Likelihood-ratio tests, I vs U. # Simulated mothers (no I vs U difference built in) are shown until the sheet is filled in; they are never # written anywhere and never go in the figure set. Sourced by app.R (local = TRUE). # ============================================================================= MOTHERS_SHEET <- "Single_Mothers" MOTHERS_COLS <- c("Mother_ID", "Status", "Males_Emerged", "Females_Emerged") # read the optional sheet from an uploaded workbook (NULL if absent or empty) read_mothers_sheet <- function(path, sheets) { if (!MOTHERS_SHEET %in% sheets) return(NULL) m <- tryCatch(readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = MOTHERS_SHEET), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(m) || !all(MOTHERS_COLS %in% names(m))) return(NULL) m <- m %>% transmute(Mother_ID = as.character(Mother_ID), Status = toupper(trimws(as.character(Status))), Status = recode(Status, WI = "I", INFECTED = "I", UNINFECTED = "U"), # "WI" accepted from older sheets Males = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Males_Emerged)), Females = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Females_Emerged)), Eggs = if ("Eggs_Host" %in% names(m)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m$Eggs_Host)) else NA_real_) %>% filter(Status %in% c("I", "U"), !is.na(Males), !is.na(Females)) if (!nrow(m)) NULL else m } simulated_mothers <- function() { set.seed(808) # same simulated mothers every session; no I vs U difference built in n <- 6; eggs <- rep(28, 2 * n) wasps <- rbinom(2 * n, eggs, 0.8); males <- rbinom(2 * n, wasps, 0.25) tibble(Mother_ID = c(sprintf("SIM-I-%02d", 1:n), sprintf("SIM-U-%02d", 1:n)), Status = rep(c("I", "U"), each = n), Males = males, Females = wasps - males, Eggs = eggs) } mothers_data <- function(tb) { real <- tb$mothers d <- if (is.null(real)) simulated_mothers() else real d <- d %>% mutate(Status = factor(Status, c("I", "U")), Wasps = Males + Females, Prop_Male = ifelse(Wasps > 0, Males / Wasps, NA_real_)) list(data = d, simulated = is.null(real)) } mothers_tests <- function(tb) mm_cached(tb, "mothers", "all", function() { md <- mothers_data(tb); d <- md$data ok <- n_distinct(d$Status) == 2 # offspring number: negative binomial GLM, Poisson if it cannot be fitted nb <- function(f) tryCatch(suppressWarnings(MASS::glm.nb(f, data = d)), error = function(e) NULL) m1 <- if (ok) nb(Wasps ~ Status) else NULL; m0 <- if (ok) nb(Wasps ~ 1) else NULL fam <- "Negative binomial GLM" if (ok && (is.null(m1) || is.null(m0))) { m1 <- glm(Wasps ~ Status, poisson, data = d); m0 <- glm(Wasps ~ 1, poisson, data = d); fam <- "Poisson GLM" } off <- if (!ok) list(chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA) else { ch <- max(0, 2 * (as.numeric(logLik(m1)) - as.numeric(logLik(m0)))); list(chisq = ch, df = 1, p = pchisq(ch, 1, lower.tail = FALSE)) } sr <- if (ok) bb_lrt(d %>% filter(Wasps > 0), male_resp, "Status") else list(chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA, n = 0) means <- d %>% group_by(Status) %>% summarise(mothers = n(), offspring = mean(Wasps), sons = sum(Males) / pmax(sum(Wasps), 1), .groups = "drop") list(offspring = c(off, model = fam, n = nrow(d)), sex_ratio = c(sr[c("chisq", "df", "p")], model = "Beta-binomial GLM", n = sum(d$Wasps > 0)), means = means, simulated = md$simulated) }) plot_mothers <- function(tb) { md <- mothers_data(tb); d <- md$data; s <- mothers_tests(tb) validate(need(n_distinct(d$Status) == 2, "Both I and U mothers are needed.")) panel <- function(yvar, ylab, t, title, k) { dd <- d %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[yvar]])) %>% mutate(xn = as.numeric(Status), y = .data[[yvar]]) lab <- paste0(t$model, ": I vs U

events")) }))), p(class = "small text-muted m-2", sprintf(paste0( "Each point in the figure is one dyad (dyads with none count as zero); the test compares events per dyad across the three conditions (Holm-adjusted over the four behaviours). ", "Power: how often the test would detect the pattern seen here, estimated by resampling dyads within each condition (%d resamples). ", "A behaviour is drawn only when power is at least %d%%; rarer behaviours are listed here so you can see why."), NB_POWER_B, round(100 * NB_POWER_MIN)))) } # ---- Threat displays: I vs U females, all dyad types pooled (conservative tests) ---- # Dyad-label permutation: dyad types are shuffled among whole dyads (a dyad's two females stay together, so the test # respects that they are not independent); statistic = threat displays per 1,000 events, I minus U; two-sided. # Fisher's exact test on the number of females with at least one threat display (ignores how many each made). NB_PERM_B <- 4999 nb_status <- function(cond, wasp) ifelse(cond == "U x U", "U", ifelse(cond == "I x I", "I", ifelse(tolower(wasp) == "red", "I", "U"))) threat_status_test <- function(tb) { if (!is.null(tb$cache$threat_status)) return(tb$cache$threat_status) ev <- tb$events %>% mutate(Wasp_ID = tolower(trimws(Wasp_ID))) fem <- ev %>% count(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID, Condition, name = "total") %>% left_join(ev %>% filter(Behaviour == "threat_display") %>% count(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID, name = "td"), by = c("Trial_ID", "Wasp_ID")) %>% mutate(td = coalesce(td, 0L), Condition = as.character(Condition), Status = nb_status(Condition, Wasp_ID)) rate <- function(st) { w <- st == "I"; 1000 * (sum(fem$td[w]) / sum(fem$total[w]) - sum(fem$td[!w]) / sum(fem$total[!w])) } obs <- rate(fem$Status); dy <- fem %>% distinct(Trial_ID, Condition) set.seed(312) p_perm <- if (sum(fem$td) == 0) NA_real_ else { null <- replicate(NB_PERM_B, { pc <- setNames(sample(dy$Condition), dy$Trial_ID); rate(nb_status(pc[fem$Trial_ID], fem$Wasp_ID)) }) (sum(abs(null) >= abs(obs) - 1e-9) + 1) / (NB_PERM_B + 1) } p_fisher <- if (sum(fem$td) == 0) NA_real_ else fisher.test(table(factor(fem$Status, c("I", "U")), factor(fem$td > 0, c(TRUE, FALSE))))$p.value res <- list(summary = fem %>% group_by(Status = factor(Status, c("I", "U"))) %>% summarise(females = n(), with_td = sum(td > 0), events = sum(td), all_events = sum(total), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(per_1000 = 1000 * events / all_events), diff = obs, p_perm = p_perm, p_fisher = p_fisher) tb$cache$threat_status <- res res } threat_status_ui <- function(tb) { r <- threat_status_test(tb); Fisher's test only asks whether a female made any threat display, not how many. ", "I females come from U x I (red) and I x I dyads; U females from U x I (yellow) and U x U dyads."))) } # ---- Figure: the trend in threat displays, I vs U females (descriptive only: no statistic on the figure; # the conservative tests are reported in the table beside it) ---- plot_threat_status <- function(tb) { ev <- tb$events %>% mutate(Wasp_ID = tolower(trimws(Wasp_ID))) fem <- ev %>% count(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID, Condition, name = "total") %>% left_join(ev %>% filter(Behaviour == "threat_display") %>% count(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID, name = "td"), by = c("Trial_ID", "Wasp_ID")) %>% mutate(td = coalesce(td, 0L), Condition = as.character(Condition), Status = factor(nb_status(Condition, Wasp_ID), c("I", "U")), rate = 100 * td / total, Dyad = ifelse(Condition == "U x I", "Mixed dyad (U x I)", "Same-status dyad")) validate(need(sum(fem$td) > 0, "No threat displays recorded in the data shown.")) s <- fem %>% group_by(Status) %>% summarise(lab = sprintf("%d of %d females\n%d threat display%s\n%.2f per 100 events", sum(td > 0), n(), sum(td), ifelse(sum(td) == 1, "", "s"), 100 * sum(td) / sum(total)), .groups = "drop") ggplot(fem, aes(Status, rate, colour = Status)) + box_outline(width = 0.45) + geom_point(aes(shape = Dyad), position = position_jitter(width = 0.14, height = 0, seed = 1), alpha = 0.4, size = 2.8) + stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 4, fill = "white", stroke = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) + geom_text(data = s, aes(Status, Inf, label = lab), vjust = 1.2, size = 3.4, colour = "grey30", lineheight = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE) + scale_colour_manual(values = outline_cols, guide = "none") + scale_shape_manual(values = c("Mixed dyad (U x I)" = 17, "Same-status dyad" = 16), name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.45))) + labs(x = "Female", y = "Threat displays per 100 of her events", caption = "Each point is one female; diamond = mean.
