# ============================================================================= # SEX RATIO AND EMERGENCE (Lab 8) # One row per egg mass (= trial). Uses the Lab 8 emergence columns in Trial_Metadata # (Males_Emerged, Females_Emerged, Host_Nymphs_Emerged, Unemerged_Eggs). Until those # are filled in, the pages show SIMULATED counts generated from the real Lab 6 trials # (egg counts, ovipositions, superparasitism), clearly labelled. Simulated values are # never written to the workbook. # Models: beta-binomial GLMs for the proportion of males and for offspring survival, tested by # likelihood ratio (chi-square). Sourced by app.R (local = TRUE). # ============================================================================= # ---------- beta-binomial GLM (maximum likelihood) ---------- # Same model and parameterisation as glmmTMB(family = betabinomial): mean mu = plogis(X b), dispersion phi, # k ~ BetaBinomial(n, a = mu * phi, b = (1 - mu) * phi). Written out here because the glmmTMB build in the # web version of R cannot be loaded (it needs a newer TMB than the web repository has); results match glmmTMB. bb_glm <- function(formula, data) { mf <- model.frame(formula, data); y <- model.response(mf); k <- y[, 1]; n <- y[, 1] + y[, 2] tt <- terms(mf); X <- model.matrix(tt, mf) start <- c(suppressWarnings(coef(glm.fit(X, cbind(k, n - k), family = binomial()))), log(10)) start[!is.finite(start)] <- 0 nll <- function(th) { mu <- plogis(drop(X %*% th[seq_len(ncol(X))])); phi <- exp(th[ncol(X) + 1]) mu <- pmin(pmax(mu, 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10); a <- mu * phi; b <- (1 - mu) * phi -sum(lchoose(n, k) + lbeta(k + a, n - k + b) - lbeta(a, b)) } o <- nlminb(start, nll, control = list(iter.max = 1000, eval.max = 2000)) if (!is.finite(o$objective)) stop("beta-binomial fit failed") structure(list(coef = setNames(o$par[seq_len(ncol(X))], colnames(X)), phi = exp(o$par[ncol(X) + 1]), loglik = -o$objective, df = ncol(X) + 1, nobs = nrow(X), terms = delete.response(tt), xlevels = .getXlevels(tt, mf), contrasts = attr(X, "contrasts")), class = "bb_glm") } logLik.bb_glm <- function(object, ...) structure(object$loglik, df = object$df, nobs = object$nobs, class = "logLik") predict.bb_glm <- function(object, newdata, type = "response", ...) { X <- model.matrix(object$terms, model.frame(object$terms, newdata, xlev = object$xlevels), contrasts.arg = object$contrasts) eta <- drop(X %*% object$coef); if (type == "response") plogis(eta) else eta } fixef.bb_glm <- function(object, ...) list(cond = object$coef) EMERGENCE_COLS <- c("Males_Emerged", "Females_Emerged", "Host_Nymphs_Emerged", "Unemerged_Eggs") SIM_NOTE <- "SIMULATED emergence counts (none entered yet)" # superparasitism per egg mass from the oviposit events (same rule as the Trial_Metadata columns) superparasitism_table <- function(events, metadata) { eggs <- metadata %>% transmute(Trial_ID, Eggs = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Eggs_Host))) ov <- events %>% filter(Behaviour == "oviposit") %>% arrange(Trial_ID, Time_sec) wasps <- ov %>% count(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID) out <- eggs %>% left_join( wasps %>% group_by(Trial_ID) %>% summarise(Total_Ovi = sum(n), Max_Female = max(n), Min_Female = ifelse(n() == 2, min(n), 0L), Females_Laying = n(), .groups = "drop"), by = "Trial_ID") %>% mutate(across(c(Total_Ovi, Max_Female, Min_Female, Females_Laying), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L))) # dyad superparasitism: one female alone laid >= Eggs, so the other female's eggs share hosts with her out <- out %>% mutate(Excess = pmax(0, Total_Ovi - Eggs), Self_Super = pmax(0, Max_Female - Eggs) + pmax(0, Min_Female - Eggs), Dyad_Super = ifelse(!is.na(Eggs) & Max_Female >= Eggs, Min_Female, 0L)) # prefer the checked superparasitism columns in Trial_Metadata (they use oviposition timing for direction) wb <- c("Self_Superparasitism_Red", "Self_Superparasitism_Yellow", "Dyad_Superparasitism_by_Red", "Dyad_Superparasitism_by_Yellow") if (all(wb %in% names(metadata))) { m <- metadata %>% transmute(Trial_ID, across(all_of(wb), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) out <- out %>% left_join(m, by = "Trial_ID") %>% mutate(Self_Super = coalesce(Self_Superparasitism_Red + Self_Superparasitism_Yellow, Self_Super), Dyad_Super = coalesce(Dyad_Superparasitism_by_Red + Dyad_Superparasitism_by_Yellow, Dyad_Super)) %>% select(-all_of(wb)) } out %>% mutate( Shared = ifelse(Females_Laying == 2, "Both females laid", "One female laid"), Parasitized = pmin(Eggs, Total_Ovi), Excess_per_egg = Excess / Eggs, # superparasitism observed (inferred from the counts): more ovipositions than eggs, by self or dyad Superparasitized = ifelse(Excess > 0 | Self_Super > 0 | Dyad_Super > 0, "Superparasitized", "Not superparasitized")) } # deterministic simulation of emergence counts from the real trials (for demonstration only) simulate_emergence <- function(sp, seed = 2026) { set.seed(seed) n <- nrow(sp) phi <- 12 # beta-binomial precision (extra variation among masses) p_male <- plogis(qlogis(0.12) + 0.65 * (sp$Shared == "Both females laid") + 1.2 * sp$Excess_per_egg + 0.9 * (sp$Dyad_Super > 0)) p_survive <- plogis(qlogis(0.92) - 2.0 * sp$Excess_per_egg) wasps <- rbinom(n, sp$Parasitized, p_survive) pm <- rbeta(n, p_male * phi, (1 - p_male) * phi) males <- rbinom(n, wasps, pm) # no host nymphs: every egg that did not produce a wasp counts as unemerged (author, 24 Nov) tibble(Trial_ID = sp$Trial_ID, Males = males, Females = wasps - males, Hosts = 0L, Unemerged = sp$Eggs - wasps) } # Once real counts are in, the desktop folder of SIMULATED preview images is out of date: send it to the # Recycle Bin (recoverable) so nobody mistakes it for results. Safety: only this exact folder, only when it # holds nothing but .png images, and only after the dashboard has switched to entered counts. SIM_PREVIEW_DIR <- file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), "Desktop", "Biol 312", "Lab 8", "Sex_Ratio_Dashboard_Preview_SIMULATED") retire_simulated_previews <- function(emergence, dir = SIM_PREVIEW_DIR) { if (isTRUE(emergence$simulated) || nrow(emergence$data) == 0 || !dir.exists(dir)) return(invisible(FALSE)) files <- list.files(dir, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, include.dirs = TRUE) if (!length(files) || !all(grepl("\\.png$", files, ignore.case = TRUE))) { message("Simulated preview folder kept: it contains files other than .png images: ", dir); return(invisible(FALSE)) } ps <- sprintf("Add-Type -AssemblyName Microsoft.VisualBasic; [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteDirectory('%s', 'OnlyErrorDialogs', 'SendToRecycleBin')", gsub("'", "''", normalizePath(dir, winslash = "\\"))) try(system2("powershell", c("-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", shQuote(ps, type = "cmd")), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE), silent = TRUE) ok <- !dir.exists(dir) message(if (ok) "Real emergence counts found: simulated preview folder sent to the Recycle Bin: " else "Could not remove simulated preview folder: ", dir) invisible(ok) } build_emergence <- function(metadata, tables) { sp <- superparasitism_table(tables$events, metadata) num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)) # SWITCH TO REAL DATA: as soon as ANY egg mass has both Males_Emerged and Females_Emerged entered, every page # uses the entered counts only (simulated values are dropped entirely, never mixed in). A mass is included once # both its male and female counts are entered (0 counts as entered); half-entered masses wait until complete. have <- all(EMERGENCE_COLS %in% names(metadata)) && any(!is.na(num(metadata$Males_Emerged)) & !is.na(num(metadata$Females_Emerged))) if (have) { em <- metadata %>% transmute(Trial_ID, Males = num(Males_Emerged), Females = num(Females_Emerged), Hosts = num(Host_Nymphs_Emerged), Unemerged = num(Unemerged_Eggs)) %>% filter(!is.na(Males), !is.na(Females)) simulated <- FALSE } else { em <- simulate_emergence(sp) simulated <- TRUE } contest <- tables$trial_summary %>% select(Trial_ID, Winner_Share = max_prop_oviposition) aggr <- tables$events %>% group_by(Trial_ID) %>% summarise(Dyad_Aggression = mean(State == "Aggression"), .groups = "drop") owner <- tables$analysis_df %>% group_by(Trial_ID) %>% summarise(Owner_Won = if (any(status == "winner")) ifelse(any(status == "winner" & arrival_rank == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "Owner won", "Intruder won") else NA_character_, .groups = "drop") d <- em %>% left_join(sp, by = "Trial_ID") %>% left_join(metadata %>% select(Trial_ID, Condition) %>% distinct() %>% mutate(Condition = droplevels(condition_factor(Condition))), # U x U, U x I, I x I (see app.R) by = "Trial_ID") %>% left_join(contest, by = "Trial_ID") %>% left_join(aggr, by = "Trial_ID") %>% left_join(owner, by = "Trial_ID") %>% mutate(Wasps = Males + Females, Prop_Male = ifelse(Wasps > 0, Males / Wasps, NA_real_), Total_Counted = Males + Females + coalesce(Hosts, 0) + coalesce(Unemerged, 0), Count_Check = ifelse(!is.na(Eggs) & Total_Counted != Eggs, "Does not add up to Eggs_Host", "OK"), Survival = ifelse(Parasitized > 0, pmin(1, Wasps / Parasitized), NA_real_)) list(data = d, simulated = simulated) } # ---------- models ---------- fmt_p2 <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 1e-4, "P < 0.0001", sprintf("P = %.4f", p))) bb_lrt <- function(d, resp, rhs, null = "1") { d <- d %>% filter(if_all(all_of(all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", rhs)))), ~ !is.na(.x))) f1 <- as.formula(paste(resp, "~", rhs)); f0 <- as.formula(paste(resp, "~", null)) m1 <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bb_glm(f1, d)), error = function(e) NULL) m0 <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bb_glm(f0, d)), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(m1) || is.null(m0)) return(list(chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA, n = nrow(d), fit = NULL)) ll <- 2 * (as.numeric(logLik(m1)) - as.numeric(logLik(m0))) df <- attr(logLik(m1), "df") - attr(logLik(m0), "df") list(chisq = ll, df = df, p = pchisq(ll, df, lower.tail = FALSE), n = nrow(d), fit = m1) } lrt_text <- function(t, label = "Beta-binomial GLM") { sub_digits <- function(x) chartr("0123456789", "₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉", as.character(x)) if (is.na(t$chisq)) return(paste0(label, ": model could not be fitted")) paste0(label, "\nχ²(", t$df, ") = ", sprintf("%.2f", t$chisq), ", ", fmt_p2(t$p), ifelse(!is.na(t$p) && t$p < 0.05, "*", ""), ", n = ", t$n) } male_resp <- "cbind(Males, Females)" surv_resp <- "cbind(Wasps, pmax(Parasitized - Wasps, 0))" sex_ratio_predictors <- c("Superparasitized vs not" = "Superparasitized", "Excess ovipositions per egg" = "Excess_per_egg", "Self-superparasitism" = "Self_Super", "Dyad superparasitism" = "Dyad_Super", "One vs both females laid" = "Shared") contest_predictors <- c("Winner's share of ovipositions" = "Winner_Share", "Aggression in the dyad" = "Dyad_Aggression", "Total ovipositions" = "Total_Ovi", "Owner vs intruder won" = "Owner_Won") pred_label <- function(k) { all <- c(sex_ratio_predictors, contest_predictors); names(all)[match(k, all)] } sim_layer <- function(sim) if (isTRUE(sim)) labs(caption = SIM_NOTE) else NULL sim_theme <- theme(plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#B5523B", face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0)) stat_label <- function(txt) annotate("label", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = txt, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4.1, family = plot_font, linewidth = 0, fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) # ---------- plots ---------- plot_emergence_summary <- function(tb) { em <- tb$emergence; d <- em$data validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No emergence counts yet.")) long <- d %>% select(Condition, Trial_ID, Eggs, Count_Check, Males, Females, Unemerged) %>% pivot_longer(c(Males, Females, Unemerged), names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "n") %>% mutate(Outcome = factor(recode(Outcome, Unemerged = "Unemerged eggs"), levels = c("Unemerged eggs", "Females", "Males"))) flags <- d %>% filter(Count_Check != "OK") ggplot(long, aes(Trial_ID, n, fill = Outcome)) + geom_col(width = 0.75) + geom_point(data = d, aes(Trial_ID, Eggs), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 95, size = 9, colour = "black") + { if (nrow(flags)) geom_text(data = flags, aes(Trial_ID, Total_Counted, label = "!"), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, colour = "#B5523B", fontface = "bold", size = 6) } + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Males = "#009E73", Females = "#D55E00", `Unemerged eggs` = "#E3E6E8"), # sexes as EMERG_SEX_COL breaks = c("Males", "Females", "Unemerged eggs"), name = NULL) + facet_wrap(~ Condition, scales = "free_x") + labs(x = "Egg mass (trial)", y = "Number of eggs") + sim_layer(em$simulated) + theme_dash() + sim_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) } condition_combos <- function(conds) { cs <- if (is.factor(conds)) levels(droplevels(conds)) else sort(unique(conds)); out <- list(); out[["All conditions"]] <- cs if (length(cs) > 2) for (p in combn(cs, 2, simplify = FALSE)) out[[paste(p, collapse = " vs ")]] <- p out } # dyad type in ONE beta-binomial model (one row per egg mass = dyad, so no random effect is needed), with the # same planned (Holm) and post hoc (Scheffe) contrasts as the Dyad Types pages (see mixed_models.R) sr_dyad_tests <- function(tb, resp = male_resp) mm_cached(tb, "sr_dyad", paste(resp, tb$key_all), function() { # also depends on emergence counts d <- tb$emergence$data %>% filter(if (resp == male_resp) Wasps > 0 else Parasitized > 0) %>% mutate(Grp = factor(as.character(Condition), DYAD_LEVELS), value = if (resp == male_resp) Prop_Male else Survival) fit <- function(rhs, dd) tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bb_glm(as.formula(paste(resp, "~", rhs)), dd)), error = function(e) NULL) lr <- function(m1, m0) { if (is.null(m1) || is.null(m0)) return(NA_TEST) ll <- 2 * (as.numeric(logLik(m1)) - as.numeric(logLik(m0))); df <- attr(logLik(m1), "df") - attr(logLik(m0), "df") list(chisq = ll, df = df, p = pchisq(ll, df, lower.tail = FALSE)) } if (!all(DYAD_LEVELS %in% d$Grp)) return(row_of("sr", resp, OMNI, NA_TEST, nrow(d), nrow(d))) m1 <- fit("Grp", d) omni <- row_of("sr", resp, OMNI, lr(m1, fit("1", d)), nrow(d), nrow(d), fam = "betabinomial") cs <- bind_rows(lapply(names(CONTRASTS), function(cn) { w <- CONTRASTS[[cn]]$w; dd <- add_constraint(d, "Grp", DYAD_LEVELS, w) row_of("sr", resp, cn, lr(m1, fit(paste(attr(dd, "vcols"), collapse = " + "), dd)), nrow(d), nrow(d), side_higher(d, w, DYAD_LEVELS), fam = "betabinomial", type = CONTRASTS[[cn]]$type) })) bind_rows(omni, adjust_contrasts(cs, omni$df)) }) plot_sex_ratio_condition <- function(tb) { em <- tb$emergence; d <- em$data %>% filter(Wasps > 0) %>% mutate(Grp = factor(as.character(Condition), DYAD_LEVELS)) validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No wasps emerged yet."), need(all(DYAD_LEVELS %in% d$Grp), "All three dyad types are needed.")) s <- sr_dyad_tests(tb); o <- row_get(s, OMNI); pc <- row_get(s, POOLED) lab <- paste0("Beta-binomial GLM (one egg mass per dyad)
Dyad type: ", chi_html(o$chisq, o$df, o$p, o$n), " egg masses
", "U x I vs the other two: ", chi_html(pc$chisq, pc$df, pc$p, adj = "Holm")) ggplot(d, aes(Grp, Prop_Male, colour = Grp)) + scale_x_discrete() + box_outline(width = 0.5) + geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 1), alpha = 0.4, shape = 16, size = 2.6) + dyad_brackets(s, d %>% mutate(y = Prop_Male), "male") + scale_colour_manual(values = outline_cols, guide = "none") + stat_text(tibble(lab = lab), 3.4) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.6))) + labs(x = "Dyad type", y = "Proportion of offspring male") + sim_layer(em$simulated) + theme_dash() + sim_theme + theme(legend.position = "top") } plot_sex_ratio_predictor <- function(tb, key, resp = male_resp, yvar = "Prop_Male", ylab = "Proportion of offspring male") { em <- tb$emergence; d <- em$data %>% filter(if (yvar == "Prop_Male") Wasps > 0 else Parasitized > 0) validate(need(nrow(d) > 2, "Not enough egg masses yet."), need(key %in% names(d), "Choose a predictor.")) d <- d %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[key]])) t <- bb_lrt(d, resp, key) base <- ggplot(d, aes(.data[[key]], .data[[yvar]])) + labs(x = pred_label(key), y = ylab) + sim_layer(em$simulated) if (is.character(d[[key]])) { p <- base + box_outline(width = 0.5, colour = "black") + geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 1), alpha = 0.4, shape = 16, size = 2.6, colour = "grey30") + sig_brackets(tibble(x1 = 1, x2 = 2, lev = 1, lab = sig_label(t$p)), d %>% mutate(y = .data[[yvar]])) } else { nd <- tibble(!!key := seq(min(d[[key]], na.rm = TRUE), max(d[[key]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)) if (!is.null(t$fit)) nd$fit <- predict(t$fit, newdata = nd, type = "response") p <- base + geom_point(alpha = 0.4, shape = 16, size = 2.6, colour = "grey30") + { if (!is.null(t$fit)) geom_line(data = nd, aes(.data[[key]], fit), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) } } p + stat_label(lrt_text(t)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.3))) + theme_dash() + sim_theme } plot_survival <- function(tb, key) plot_sex_ratio_predictor(tb, key, resp = surv_resp, yvar = "Survival", ylab = "Survival (wasps / hosts parasitized)") # ---------- stats cards ---------- emergence_stats <- function(tb) { em <- tb$emergence; "), "No emergence counts have been entered in the workbook yet, so these pages show simulated counts ", "generated from the real Lab 6 trials (egg counts, ovipositions and superparasitism) to illustrate the analyses. ", "They switch to the real counts as soon as Males_Emerged and Females_Emerged are filled in on Trial_Metadata.") else NULL # ---------- female and male emergence per host egg, by dyad type (section 1, second figure) ---------- # The authors' model, one per sex: cbind(wasps of that sex, Eggs_Host - wasps) ~ dyad type + (1 | dyad), binomial. # With one egg mass per dyad the dyad random effect absorbs extra-binomial variation between egg masses. # Fitted with lme4::glmer (glmmTMB cannot run in the browser; the two agree to < 0.002 on the fixed effects). # Test: Wald chi-square for dyad type (as car::Anova); estimates on the response scale with 95% CIs (as emmeans). # Figure: bars = mean of the per-egg-mass proportion, error bars = 95% CI of that mean (t), points = egg masses. # =============================================================================
# SIMULATED CLASS DATASET (shown when no workbook has been uploaded)
# Generates a whole class workbook (Trial_Metadata + Behaviour_Events) from SUMMARY parameters only
# (sim_params.R: status-specific behaviour transition probabilities, events per female, timing, targets,
# egg-mass sizes). No real trial, female or event is included. Deterministic for a given seed, so every
# student sees the same demonstration data. Emergence counts are left blank, so the Sex Ratio pages use their
# own simulated counts (sex_ratio.R). Sourced by app.R (local = TRUE).
# =============================================================================

simulate_class <- function(seed = 312, trials_per_type = 10) {
  P <- SIM_PARAMS; set.seed(seed)
  beh <- P$behaviours
  types <- rep(c("U x U", "U x I", "I x I"), each = trials_per_type)
  code <- c("U x U" = "UU", "U x I" = "UI", "I x I" = "II")
  ids <- sprintf("SIM-%s-%02d", code[types], ave(seq_along(types), types, FUN = seq_along))
  eggs <- pmin(P$eggs[["max"]], pmax(P$eggs[["min"]], round(rnorm(length(ids), P$eggs[["mean"]], P$eggs[["sd"]]))))
  metadata <- tibble(Trial_ID = ids, Condition = types, Date = as.Date("2026-11-20"), Observer = "Simulated",
                     Wasp_Species = "tj", Host_Species = "Halyomorpha halys", Eggs_Host = eggs,
                     Wasp1_Colour = "red", Wasp2_Colour = "yellow", Notes = "SIMULATED trial (demonstration data)")
  one_female <- function(trial, colour, status) {
    n <- max(8, rnbinom(1, mu = P$events_per_female[[status]][["mu"]], size = P$events_per_female[[status]][["size"]]))
    Tm <- P$transition[[status]]
    b <- character(n); b[1] <- sample(beh, 1, prob = P$init)
    for (i in seq_len(n)[-1]) b[i] <- sample(beh, 1, prob = Tm[b[i - 1], ])
    t <- round(exp(rnorm(1, P$first_event_log[["meanlog"]], P$first_event_log[["sdlog"]])) +
                 cumsum(c(0, exp(rnorm(n - 1, P$gap_log[["meanlog"]], P$gap_log[["sdlog"]])))))
    tg <- vapply(b, function(x) sample(c("egg", "rival", "arena"), 1, prob = P$target[x, ]), "")
    if (!any(tg == "egg")) tg[which(b %in% c("drum", "oviposit", "probe", "grasp_egg", "guarding"))[1] %||% 1] <- "egg"   # every female reaches the eggs
    tibble(Trial_ID = trial, Time_sec = t, Wasp_ID = colour, Behaviour = b, Target = unname(tg), Notes = NA_character_)
  }
  events <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(ids), function(i) {
    st <- switch(types[i], "U x U" = c("U", "U"), "I x I" = c("I", "I"), "U x I" = c("I", "U"))   # U x I: red is I
    bind_rows(one_female(ids[i], "red", st[1]), one_female(ids[i], "yellow", st[2])) %>% arrange(Time_sec)
  }))
  list(metadata = metadata, events = events)
}

# analysis tables for the simulated class (same pipeline as an upload)
simulated_tables <- function() {
  sim <- simulate_class()
  tb <- tables_from_sheets(sim$metadata, sim$events)
  tb$simulated_class <- TRUE
  tb
}

name: state_perm.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# PERMUTATION TESTS ON TRANSITIONS BETWEEN BEHAVIOURAL STATES (Behavioural Transitions page)
# Same method as Condition_Analysis/R_scripts/state_transition_perm.R. Sourced by app.R after state_transitions.R.
# One row per female: counts of her 25 state-to-state transitions (staying in a state included).
# Statistic: stratified G (does the next-state distribution differ between groups, summed over current states).
# Between the two females of a dyad: labels swapped at random within each dyad (paired permutation).
#   I vs U within U x I; winner vs loser within same-status dyads (U x U, I x I: infection status cannot confound
#   it, unlike U x I where the I female usually won); owner vs intruder (Holm across the three); control: red vs yellow
#   within same-status dyads. Each is also run without transitions into or out of oviposition, because winners
#   are defined by their ovipositions.
# Among dyads: dyad-type labels permuted among whole dyads (overall; planned U x I vs the other two and
#   U x U vs I x I, Holm; post hoc pairs, Holm), and whether dyads differ at all (females permuted among dyads).
# =============================================================================
STATE_NPERM <- 1999   # smallest possible P = 0.0005; fast enough in the browser

state_female_counts <- function(tb, exclude = NULL) {
  cells <- as.vector(outer(STATE_LEVELS, STATE_LEVELS, paste, sep = "->"))
  roles <- tb$analysis_df %>% transmute(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID = tolower(Wasp_ID), status = as.character(status), arrival_rank)
  D <- tb$events %>% filter(!is.na(next_behaviour)) %>%
    mutate(Wasp_ID = tolower(Wasp_ID),
           cell = factor(paste(behaviour_category(Behaviour), behaviour_category(next_behaviour), sep = "->"), cells)) %>%
    count(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID, cell, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(Trial_ID, Wasp_ID) %>% filter(sum(n) > 0) %>% ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cell, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    left_join(tb$metadata %>% transmute(Trial_ID, Condition = as.character(condition_factor(Condition))), by = "Trial_ID") %>%
    left_join(roles, by = c("Trial_ID", "Wasp_ID")) %>%
    mutate(Type = case_when(Condition == "U x U" ~ "U", Condition == "I x I" ~ "I", Wasp_ID == "red" ~ "I", TRUE ~ "U"))
  attr(D, "cells") <- if (is.null(exclude)) cells else cells[!grepl(exclude, cells)]
  D
}
state_G <- function(M) {
  fr <- factor(sub("->.*", "", colnames(M))); colt <- colSums(M); tot_f <- tapply(colt, fr, sum)
  function(g) {
    O <- rowsum(M, g)
    rg <- matrix(sapply(levels(fr), function(b) rowSums(O[, fr == b, drop = FALSE])), nrow = nrow(O))
    E <- rg[, as.integer(fr), drop = FALSE] * rep(colt / tot_f[as.integer(fr)], each = nrow(O))
    k <- O > 0 & E > 0; 2 * sum(O[k] * log(O[k] / E[k]))
  }
}
state_perm_row <- function(comparison, type, d, cells, obs, null)
  tibble(comparison, type, dyads = n_distinct(d$Trial_ID), females = nrow(d), transitions = sum(as.matrix(d[, cells])),
         G = obs, P = if (is.na(obs)) NA_real_ else (sum(null >= obs - 1e-9) + 1) / (length(null) + 1))
state_paired <- function(d, cells, comparison, type) {
  d <- d %>% group_by(Trial_ID) %>% filter(n() == 2, n_distinct(lab) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(Trial_ID, lab)
  if (n_distinct(d$Trial_ID) < 3) return(state_perm_row(comparison, type, d, cells, NA_real_, numeric()))
  G <- state_G(as.matrix(d[, cells])); g0 <- d$lab; idx <- matrix(seq_len(nrow(d)), 2)
  null <- replicate(STATE_NPERM, { sw <- runif(ncol(idx)) < 0.5; g <- g0
    g[idx[1, sw]] <- g0[idx[2, sw]]; g[idx[2, sw]] <- g0[idx[1, sw]]; G(g) })
  state_perm_row(comparison, type, d, cells, G(g0), null)
}
state_dyadtype <- function(D, cells, comparison, type, keep = DYAD_LEVELS, merge = NULL) {
  d <- D %>% filter(Condition %in% keep)
  if (!is.null(merge)) d$Condition <- ifelse(d$Condition %in% merge, "pooled", d$Condition)
  dy <- d %>% distinct(Trial_ID, Condition)
  if (n_distinct(dy$Condition) < 2) return(state_perm_row(comparison, type, d, cells, NA_real_, numeric()))
  G <- state_G(as.matrix(d[, cells])); lab_of <- function(lv) lv[match(d$Trial_ID, dy$Trial_ID)]
  state_perm_row(comparison, type, d, cells, G(lab_of(dy$Condition)), replicate(STATE_NPERM, G(lab_of(sample(dy$Condition)))))
}
state_between_females <- function(D) {
  cells <- attr(D, "cells")
  a <- bind_rows(
    state_paired(D %>% filter(Condition == "U x I") %>% mutate(lab = Type), cells, "I vs U female within U x I", "design"),
    state_paired(D %>% filter(Condition %in% c("U x U", "I x I"), status %in% c("winner", "loser")) %>% mutate(lab = status), cells,
                 "Winner vs loser within same-status dyads", "contest"),
    state_paired(D %>% filter(arrival_rank %in% c(1, 2)) %>% mutate(lab = ifelse(arrival_rank == 1, "owner", "intruder")),
                 cells, "Owner vs intruder", "contest"))
  a$P_raw <- a$P; a$P <- p.adjust(a$P, "holm"); a$adj <- "Holm"
  bind_rows(a, state_paired(D %>% filter(Condition %in% c("U x U", "I x I")) %>% mutate(lab = Wasp_ID), cells,
                            "Control: red vs yellow within same-status dyads", "control") %>% mutate(P_raw = P, adj = ""))
}
state_perm_tests <- function(tb) mm_cached(tb, "state_perm", "all", function() {
  seed <- if (exists(".Random.seed", globalenv())) get(".Random.seed", globalenv()) else NULL
  on.exit(if (!is.null(seed)) assign(".Random.seed", seed, globalenv()))   # leave the session's random stream as it was
  set.seed(312)
  D <- state_female_counts(tb); cells <- attr(D, "cells")
  A <- state_between_females(D)
  A$P_noovi <- state_between_females(state_female_counts(tb, exclude = "Oviposition"))$P
  omni <- state_dyadtype(D, cells, "All three dyad types", "overall") %>% mutate(P_raw = P, adj = "")
  pl <- bind_rows(state_dyadtype(D, cells, "U x I vs the other two", "planned", merge = c("U x U", "I x I")),
                  state_dyadtype(D, cells, "U x U vs I x I", "planned", keep = c("U x U", "I x I")))
  pl$P_raw <- pl$P; pl$P <- p.adjust(pl$P, "holm"); pl$adj <- "Holm"
  ph <- bind_rows(state_dyadtype(D, cells, "U x U vs U x I", "post hoc", keep = c("U x U", "U x I")),
                  state_dyadtype(D, cells, "U x I vs I x I", "post hoc", keep = c("U x I", "I x I")))
  ph$P_raw <- ph$P; ph$P <- p.adjust(ph$P, "holm"); ph$adj <- "Holm"
  G <- state_G(as.matrix(D[, cells]))
  het <- state_perm_row("Dyads differ from one another", "dyads", D, cells, G(D$Trial_ID),
                        replicate(STATE_NPERM, G(sample(D$Trial_ID)))) %>% mutate(P_raw = P, adj = "")
  bind_rows(A %>% mutate(block = "Between the two females of a dyad"),
            bind_rows(omni, pl, ph, het) %>% mutate(block = "Among dyads", P_noovi = NA_real_))
})
p_perm <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "not testable", sprintf("P = %.4f", p))   # permutation P (smallest 0.0005)

# figure: state networks of the two females of a dyad (I vs U in U x I; winners vs losers in same-status dyads)
plot_state_females <- function(tb) {
  D <- state_female_counts(tb); cells <- attr(D, "cells")
  long <- D %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(cells), names_to = "cell", values_to = "n") %>%
    mutate(from = factor(sub("->.*", "", cell), STATE_LEVELS), to = factor(sub(".*->", "", cell), STATE_LEVELS))
  panels <- c("I females in U x I", "U females in U x I", "Winners (same-status dyads)", "Losers (same-status dyads)")
  cnt <- bind_rows(long %>% filter(Condition == "U x I", Type == "I") %>% mutate(Panel = panels[1]),
                   long %>% filter(Condition == "U x I", Type == "U") %>% mutate(Panel = panels[2]),
                   long %>% filter(Condition != "U x I", status == "winner") %>% mutate(Panel = panels[3]),
                   long %>% filter(Condition != "U x I", status == "loser") %>% mutate(Panel = panels[4])) %>%
    group_by(Panel, from, to) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  validate(need(nrow(cnt) > 0 && sum(cnt$n) > 0, "Not enough U x I dyads or contests yet."))
  s <- state_perm_tests(tb)
  lab <- function(cmp) { x <- s[s$comparison == cmp, ]
    sprintf("G = %.1f, %s (Holm); without oviposition %s", x$G, p_perm(x$P), p_perm(x$P_noovi)) }
  plot_state_network(tb, state_probs(cnt, panels[panels %in% cnt$Panel])) +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("Paired permutation tests (labels swapped within each dyad, ", format(STATE_NPERM, big.mark = ","), " permutations)\n",
                           "I vs U within U x I: ", lab("I vs U female within U x I"), "\nWinner vs loser in same-status dyads: ", lab("Winner vs loser within same-status dyads"))) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey20", lineheight = 1.25, margin = margin(b = 12)))
}

# figure: state networks for all dyads and each dyad type, with the among-dyad-type permutation tests
plot_state_dyadtypes <- function(tb) {
  s <- state_perm_tests(tb); r <- function(cmp) s[s$comparison == cmp, ]
  o <- r("All three dyad types"); a <- r("U x I vs the other two"); b <- r("U x U vs I x I")
  plot_state_network(tb) +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("Permutation tests (whole dyads permuted among dyad types, ", format(STATE_NPERM, big.mark = ","), " permutations): ",
                           "all three dyad types G = ", sprintf("%.1f", o$G), ", ", p_perm(o$P),
                           "\nPlanned: U x I vs the other two ", p_perm(a$P), " (Holm); U x U vs I x I ", p_perm(b$P), " (Holm)")) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey20", lineheight = 1.25, margin = margin(b = 12)))
}

state_perm_ui <- function(tb) {
  s <- state_perm_tests(tb)
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(s)), function(j) { x <- s[j, ]; first <- j == 1 || s$block[j - 1] != x$block
    tags$tr(style = if (first) "border-top: 2px solid #1E3D2F;" else NULL,
      tags$td(if (first) tags$b(x$block) else ""), tags$td(x$comparison), tags$td(x$type), tags$td(x$dyads), tags$td(x$females),
      tags$td(ifelse(is.na(x$G), "", sprintf("%.1f", x$G))),
      tags$td(paste0(p_perm(x$P), ifelse(!is.na(x$P) & x$P < 0.05, "*", ""), ifelse(x$adj != "", paste0(" (", x$adj, ")"), ""))),
      tags$td(ifelse(is.na(x$P_noovi), "", paste0(p_perm(x$P_noovi), ifelse(x$P_noovi < 0.05, "*", ""))))) })
  tags$div(
    tags$table(class = "table table-sm align-middle",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th(""), tags$th("Comparison"), tags$th("Type"), tags$th("Dyads"), tags$th("Females"), tags$th("G"),
                         tags$th("Permutation P"), tags$th("Without oviposition"))),
      tags$tbody(rows)),
    p(class = "small text-muted",
      "Each female's transitions between the five states (staying in a state included). G: stratified G statistic (does the next state depend on the group, given the current state). ",
      "Between females: the two labels are swapped at random within each dyad, so a dyad's two females stay together; Holm-adjusted across the three comparisons. ",
      "The control compares paint colours in same-status dyads, where colour means nothing, so it should not be significant. ",
      "'Without oviposition' drops transitions into or out of oviposition: winners are defined by their ovipositions, so this checks that the difference is not built in. ",
      "Among dyads: dyad types permuted among whole dyads (planned contrasts Holm; post hoc pairs Holm); 'Dyads differ' permutes females among dyads. ",
      format(STATE_NPERM, big.mark = ","), " permutations; smallest possible P = 0.0005. * P < 0.05."))
}

# figure-set statistics text
fs_state_perm <- function(tb) {
  s <- state_perm_tests(tb)
  c(sprintf("Permutation tests (%s permutations) on each female's transitions between behavioural states; stratified G statistic.", format(STATE_NPERM, big.mark = ",")),
    "Between females: labels swapped within each dyad (Holm across the three comparisons); 'without oviposition' drops transitions into or out of oviposition.",
    "Among dyads: dyad types permuted among whole dyads (planned contrasts Holm; post hoc pairs Holm).",
    sprintf("  %s: %s, G = %s, %s%s%s", s$block, s$comparison, ifelse(is.na(s$G), "NA", sprintf("%.1f", s$G)), p_perm(s$P),
            ifelse(s$adj != "", paste0(" (", s$adj, ")"), ""), ifelse(is.na(s$P_noovi), "", paste0("; without oviposition ", p_perm(s$P_noovi)))))
}

name: state_transitions.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# TRANSITIONS BETWEEN BEHAVIOURAL STATES (Behavioural Transitions page)
# Each behaviour is grouped into its state (behaviour_category(): aggression, assessment, guarding, oviposition,
# other = movement, grooming, waiting, etc.). Consecutive events of the same female are counted as transitions.
# Arrows: P(next state | the female leaves her current state), so the arrows out of a state sum to 1.
# Staying in a state (e.g. bite -> chase, both aggression) is shown on the node as "stays".
# Weak arrows fade (state_alpha). Descriptive figure; sourced by app.R (local = TRUE).
# =============================================================================

STATE_LEVELS <- c("Aggression", "Assessment", "Defence", "Oviposition", "Other")
STATE_LABELS <- c(Aggression = "Aggression", Assessment = "Assessment", Defence = "Guarding", Oviposition = "Oviposition",
                  Other = "Other")
STATE_FILL <- c(Aggression = "#D55E00", Assessment = "#0072B2", Defence = "#CC79A7", Oviposition = "#009E73", Other = "#8C8C8C")
state_alpha <- function(p) pmin(1, pmax(0.08, p / 0.40))   # faint below p = 0.05, fully opaque from p = 0.40

# state-to-state counts per panel (all dyads, then each dyad type)
state_transitions <- function(tb) {
  e <- tb$transition_edges %>%
    mutate(from = factor(behaviour_category(Behaviour), STATE_LEVELS), to = factor(behaviour_category(next_behaviour), STATE_LEVELS),
           Condition = as.character(condition_factor(Condition)))
  panels <- c("All dyads", intersect(CONDITION_LEVELS, unique(e$Condition)))
  bind_rows(lapply(panels, function(pn) {
    d <- if (pn == "All dyads") e else filter(e, Condition == pn)
    d %>% count(from, to, wt = weight, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>% mutate(Panel = pn)
  })) %>% state_probs(panels)
}
# counts (Panel, from, to, n) -> staying and leaving probabilities per panel
state_probs <- function(cnt, panels = unique(cnt$Panel)) cnt %>%
  group_by(Panel, from) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), stay = sum(n[from == to]) / pmax(total, 1),
         leave_n = sum(n[from != to]), prob = ifelse(from != to & leave_n > 0, n / leave_n, NA_real_)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% mutate(Panel = factor(Panel, panels))

plot_state_network <- function(tb, st = state_transitions(tb)) {
  validate(need(sum(st$n) > 0, "No transitions recorded yet."))
  ang <- pi / 2 - 2 * pi * (seq_along(STATE_LEVELS) - 1) / length(STATE_LEVELS)
  pos <- tibble(state = STATE_LEVELS, x = cos(ang), y = sin(ang))
  r <- 0.24                                               # node radius in data units (arrows stop at the node edge)
  nodes <- st %>% distinct(Panel, from, total, stay) %>% rename(state = from) %>% mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
    left_join(pos, by = "state") %>%
    mutate(lab = ifelse(total > 0, paste0(STATE_LABELS[state], "\nstays ", sprintf("%.2f", stay)), STATE_LABELS[state]))
  ar <- st %>% filter(from != to, !is.na(prob), n > 0) %>% mutate(from = as.character(from), to = as.character(to)) %>%
    left_join(rename(pos, from = state, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "from") %>% left_join(rename(pos, to = state, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "to") %>%
    mutate(len = sqrt((x1 - x0)^2 + (y1 - y0)^2), ux = (x1 - x0) / len, uy = (y1 - y0) / len,
           xs = x0 + ux * r, ys = y0 + uy * r, xe = x1 - ux * (r + 0.03), ye = y1 - uy * (r + 0.03),
           # label beside its own arrow: the two directions of a pair curve to opposite sides
           mx = (xs + xe) / 2 + uy * 0.11, my = (ys + ye) / 2 - ux * 0.11,
           agg = from == "Aggression" | to == "Aggression") %>%
    arrange(prob)                                        # strong arrows drawn last, on top
  ggplot() +
    geom_curve(data = ar, aes(xs, ys, xend = xe, yend = ye, linewidth = prob, alpha = state_alpha(prob), colour = agg),
               curvature = 0.22, arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.4, "mm"), type = "closed"), lineend = "round") +
    geom_label(data = filter(ar, prob >= 0.15), aes(mx, my, label = sprintf("%.2f", prob)), size = 3.1, family = plot_font,
               fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines")) +
    geom_point(data = nodes, aes(x, y, fill = state), shape = 21, size = 23, colour = "white", stroke = 1) +
    geom_text(data = nodes, aes(x, y, label = lab), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 2.7, lineheight = 0.9, family = plot_font) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D55E00", `FALSE` = "grey40"), guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = STATE_FILL, guide = "none") +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.3, 3.4), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), name = "P(next state | leaving)") +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.4, 1.4), ylim = c(-1.35, 1.4), clip = "off") +
    facet_wrap(~ Panel, nrow = 1) +
    labs(caption = paste("Arrows: probability of each next state when a female leaves her current state (arrows out of a state sum to 1);",
                         "weak arrows fade, labels for p ≥ 0.15.\n'stays': probability that her next behaviour is in the same state.",
                         "Other = movement, grooming, waiting, arriving and leaving. Orange arrows involve aggression.")) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14, base_family = plot_font) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, margin = margin(b = 6)),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 14, 10, 14), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
}

# table: state persistence and the most likely next state, per panel
state_table <- function(tb) {
  st <- state_transitions(tb)
  st %>% group_by(Panel, from) %>%
    summarise(Transitions = first(total), Stays = first(stay),
              top = if (all(is.na(prob))) NA_character_ else paste0(STATE_LABELS[as.character(to[which.max(prob)])], " (", sprintf("%.2f", max(prob, na.rm = TRUE)), ")"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(Transitions > 0) %>%
    transmute(Panel, State = gsub("\n", " ", STATE_LABELS[as.character(from)]), Transitions, `Stays in state` = sprintf("%.2f", Stays),
              `Most likely next state when leaving` = gsub("\n", " ", top))
}

name: takeaways.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# OVERVIEW: MAIN TAKEAWAYS (no figures). Two questions, answered from the data currently shown (simulated class
# or the student's upload), each with its key test and where to find the details:
#   1. Did arrival order (DAR) matter?  owner (first on the eggs) vs intruder share of ovipositions; winners
#      first on the eggs; arrival time as a predictor of a female's share.
#   2. Did condition (dyad type) matter? dyad-type tests across measures (one model per measure, overall test),
#      competition within dyads and state transitions; and the design comparison I vs U within U x I.
# All numbers come from the same cached models as the other pages. Sourced by app.R (local = TRUE).
# =============================================================================

tk_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "not testable", ifelse(p < 1e-4, "P < 0.0001", sprintf("P = %.4f", p)))
tk_row <- function(...) tags$li(class = "mb-1", ...)

takeaway_dar <- function(tb) {
  own <- mm_contest(tb, "own"); m <- row_get(own, OMNI, "main"); i <- row_get(own, OMNI, "interaction")
  arr <- mm_contest(tb, "arr"); wl <- row_get(arr, OMNI, "main")
  pr <- mm_predictor(tb, "arrival_time"); sl <- row_get(pr, OMNI, "main")
  a <- tb$analysis_df; w <- a[a$status == "winner" & !is.na(a$arrival_rank), ]
  first <- if (nrow(w)) mean(w$arrival_rank == 1) else NA
  sig <- !is.na(m$p) && m$p < 0.05
  owner_more <- identical(m$higher, "owner")
  slope_sig <- !is.na(sl$p) && sl$p < 0.05; earlier_more <- !is.na(sl$beta) && sl$beta < 0
  head <- if (sig && owner_more) "Yes: the female that reached the eggs first laid more"
          else if (sig) "Yes, but the intruder laid more"
          else if (slope_sig && earlier_more) "Partly: earlier arrivals laid more, but owners did not lay significantly more than intruders"
          else "No clear effect of arriving first"
  list(sig = sig || slope_sig, head = head, body = tags$ul(class = "mb-2",
    tk_row(sprintf("Owner (first on the eggs) vs intruder, share of ovipositions: %s (%s)%s.", chi_plain(m),
                   if (owner_more) "owner higher" else "intruder higher", if (!is.na(m$p) && m$p >= 0.05) ", not significant" else "")),
    tk_row(sprintf("Winners were first on the eggs in %s of %d contests; winners vs losers, arrival time: %s.",
                   if (is.na(first)) "n/a" else paste0(round(100 * first), "%"), nrow(w), tk_p(wl$p))),
    tk_row(sprintf("Earlier arrival and a bigger share of ovipositions: slope %s, %s.", if (!is.na(sl$beta) && sl$beta < 0) "negative (earlier = more)" else "positive", tk_p(sl$p))),
    tk_row(sprintf("Did the arrival advantage differ among dyad types? %s.", tk_p(i$p)))),
    where = "Details: Arrival Advantage; Condition, section 2.")
}

takeaway_condition <- function(tb) {
  dy <- bind_rows(lapply(MM_DYAD_MEASURES, function(k) row_get(mm_dyad(tb, k), OMNI) %>% mutate(what = mm_label(k))))
  cp <- bind_rows(lapply(names(COMP_MEASURES), function(k) mm_comp(tb, k) %>% filter(comparison == OMNI) %>% head(1) %>% mutate(what = paste("Competition:", k))))
  st <- state_perm_tests(tb); so <- st[st$comparison == "All three dyad types", ]
  ps <- c(dy$p, cp$p, so$P); n_sig <- sum(ps < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE); n_all <- sum(!is.na(ps))
  wi <- row_get(mm_status(tb, "share"), WITHIN_UXI)
  wi_sig <- !is.na(wi$p) && wi$p < 0.05
  # the U x I result: I vs U share of ovipositions within mixed dyads, and the two females of same-status dyads
  a <- mm_data(tb) %>% filter(Condition == "U x I", !is.na(prop_oviposition))
  mean_share <- function(t) mean(a$prop_oviposition[a$Type == t])
  col <- mm_colour(tb, "prop_oviposition")
  same <- function(g) { r <- col[col$comparison == g, ]; if (nrow(r)) tk_p(r$p) else "not testable" }
  head <- if (wi_sig) paste0("Yes, in U x I dyads: the ", wi$higher, " female laid more than her ", setdiff(c("I", "U"), wi$higher), " rival")
          else "No clear effect: in U x I dyads, I and U females laid similar shares"
  sig_rows <- bind_rows(dy %>% transmute(what, p), cp %>% transmute(what, p), tibble(what = "Transitions between behavioural states", p = so$P)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p), p < 0.05)
  list(sig = wi_sig, head = head, body = tags$ul(class = "mb-2",
    tk_row(sprintf("In U x I dyads, the I female laid on average %.0f%% of the dyad's eggs and the U female %.0f%%: %s.",
                   100 * mean_share("I"), 100 * mean_share("U"), chi_plain(wi))),
    tk_row(sprintf("In same-status dyads, the two females %s (red vs yellow: U x U %s; I x I %s, Holm).",
                   if (any(col$p[col$comparison %in% c("U x U", "I x I")] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) "also differed" else "did not differ in this way",
                   same("U x U"), same("I x I"))),
    tk_row(sprintf("Comparing the three dyad types on behaviour, arrival time, competition within dyads and transitions between behavioural states: %d of %d tests significant%s.",
                   n_sig, n_all, if (nrow(sig_rows)) paste0(" (", paste(sprintf("%s, %s", tolower(sig_rows$what), tk_p(sig_rows$p)), collapse = "; "), ")") else ""))),
    where = "Details: Condition; Wasp Identity; Behavioural Transitions.")
}

takeaways_ui <- function(tb) {
  card_of <- function(q, x, icon) card(class = "h-100", style = if (x$sig) "border-left: 5px solid #1E3D2F;" else "border-left: 5px solid #B07D14;",
    card_body(
      p(class = "text-muted mb-1 small text-uppercase fw-semibold", bs_icon(icon), " ", q),
      h4(class = "mb-3", style = "font-weight:600;", x$head),
      x$body,
      p(class = "small text-muted mb-0", x$where)))
  tagList(
    layout_columns(col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card_of("Did arrival order (DAR) matter?", takeaway_dar(tb), "stopwatch"),
      card_of("Did condition (dyad type) matter?", takeaway_condition(tb), "sliders")),
    p(class = "small text-muted", "Mixed models with dyad as a random effect and likelihood-ratio tests; permutation tests for transitions. ",
      "Results are for the data shown above (the simulated class until you upload your workbook). P < 0.05 is treated as significant."))
}
